excerpt: A dark, blue-toned city appears before dawn, with the Manhattan skyline in the distance and a suspension bridge stretching toward it. The bridge walkway is empty except for a small white chicken moving along the center line, an odd, quiet figure against the wet, gloomy city. The streets also look slick with rain, reflecting building lights and the heavy clouds overhead. In the city, chickens and roosters begin appearing in places where people or traffic would normally be. At an empty intersection, several brown chickens stand and move across broad white crosswalk lines beneath tall buildings, including a pointed, triangular-topped tower in the background. On a narrow cobblestone street lined with old buildings and hanging signs, two chickens stand at the left edge, looking down the deserted road. A close view of a rooster follows: it has golden-brown feathers, a red comb and wattles, and its beak opens wide as if crowing, the blurred city canyon behind it glowing pale blue. More birds gather on urban objects. Three chickens stand on the roof of a yellow taxi, balanced around the taxi sign and license plate area; one white rooster is centered and upright, with brown chickens on either side. In a brighter, neon-lit commercial street resembling Times Square, several brown chickens rush across the wet roadway, their bodies low and legs extended mid-stride. Reflections from signs and streetlights streak across the pavement as the birds cross from both sides. Back on the bridge, a tall white rooster runs directly toward the viewer along the walkway’s greenish center stripe, with darker chickens following behind near the railings. The bridge cables and metal latticework frame the birds as they advance under the same moody blue sky. The scene then moves underground or beside a train: a row of chickens crowds along a narrow platform next to glossy train doors. A white rooster hurries past in the foreground, its tail feathers fanned out, while brown chickens peck and jostle near the door openings. At a subway entrance on a city sidewalk, roosters and hens move around the stairwell railings. A black station sign reads “West St Station,” with route numbers that appear to include “1” and “2.” The birds cluster at the top of the stairs and pass in front of the sign, their red combs and pale feathers catching the cool light from below. The scale suddenly expands. A huge crowd of chickens fills a financial district street and the steps of a grand columned building. Thousands of birds pack the plaza and roadway, surrounding a statue on a pedestal in front of the building. Close views show roosters and hens pressed together in the foreground, their feathers ranging from white to tan to deep brown, with tall skyscrapers leaning over them. Some birds stand on ledges and stone barriers, looking outward like sentries. Others crowd the steps beneath the massive columns, their heads bobbing and beaks open as if answering the earlier crowing. Daylight begins to break between tall buildings. A narrow slice of sun appears at the edge of a high-rise, growing brighter and sending lens-like flares across the street canyon. The light washes the previously blue, nocturnal city with a warmer glow. The roosters remain gathered on stone ledges and in the plaza below, many with open beaks and raised heads. One white rooster stands high on a rounded dark surface in front of the classical building, overlooking the enormous flock spread across the street below. Three brown chickens perch on metal railings, facing different directions while the crowd of birds continues to fill the background. From above, the flock becomes a dense, shifting mass in the streets, like a moving pattern of small dark and pale shapes. A wider city view shows the birds spilling down an avenue away from the columned building, occupying the road between tall office blocks while a few vehicles sit off to the sides. The city appears to be waking up, but the chickens have taken over the streets. The commercial then shifts from the rooster-filled city to broader urban scenes. A high, almost map-like view looks straight down on blocks of buildings and streets, with sunlight striking rooftops and facades. The perspective pulls away into a larger grid of the city. On the ground, a sidewalk and street are littered with scattered boxes, bags, and debris near a white service or sanitation truck. Loose papers and trash blow across the pavement, suggesting the city is busy and unsettled. Another street scene shows tall buildings framing an avenue where a dark utility truck moves through a gray, misty intersection. A white city bus crosses in front of a dramatic burst of water or steam erupting from the street. Orange-and-white traffic barrels and barriers sit near the disturbance, and mist spreads across the road. From a low angle, the bus looms large as it drives past, headlights glowing, while debris and dark fragments swirl behind it in the bright, backlit haze between the buildings. The view then rises far above the city. Lower Manhattan appears as a compact cluster of skyscrapers surrounded by water, softened by morning haze. The city recedes until it becomes small within a broad expanse of blue-gray atmosphere. The image continues outward to the curve of the Earth from space. Clouds, ocean, and landmasses are visible beneath a dark sky dotted with faint stars. Sunlight grows at the edge of the planet, brightening into a strong glow that spills over the horizon. The final image becomes a clean, pale background with a blurred blue-and-green “ca” mark emerging. A thin black circle appears to the left of the letters, overlapping the blue “c” as the logo sharpens. Beneath it, gray text reads “Computer Associates.” The ending is simple and uncluttered, identifying the company after the sweeping sequence of citywide roosters, morning light, urban activity, and the Earth from space.

The commercial opens on a sunlit city intersection with a wide, freshly painted white crosswalk stretching toward the viewer. Storefronts, parked cars, and pedestrians line the street. A young adult Black man with a muscular build walks straight down the crosswalk toward the viewer. He wears a loose olive-green sleeveless tank top, dark pants, black shoes, a black cap or durag tied at the back, a thin gold chain, and a bracelet. His expression is relaxed and confident. As he approaches, the street behind him becomes busier with people on the sidewalks and cars along the curb. The view shifts upward to a brick apartment building with black metal fire escapes. A young adult woman with long dark hair, wearing a reddish top and shorts, sits behind the railing on a small fire-escape landing. She looks outward from above, calm and observant, with the metal stairs and railings forming a grid around her. Back on the sidewalk, the young man walks beside closed metal storefront shutters, holding a red Dr Pepper can in one hand. He looks up toward the buildings and smiles slightly, as if acknowledging someone above. A wider sidewalk view shows him passing a red storefront with white plastic chairs outside and people further down the block. A teenage or young adult Black man appears behind a chain-link fence, close to the viewer. He wears a dark V-neck jersey with white trim. One hand grips the fence while the other lifts a red Dr Pepper can to his mouth. The white Dr Pepper logo is visible on the can as he drinks, then lowers it and looks forward with a composed, satisfied expression through the diamond pattern of the fence. The main young man continues through the neighborhood with the Dr Pepper can hanging casually at his side. The background is bright and slightly soft, with pedestrians moving past in both directions. He glances to the side and smiles. An ice cream truck appears at the curb, its serving window open. A smiling Black male vendor in a black-and-white raglan shirt leans out to serve children gathered below. A girl reaches up toward the window, and the truck side shows colorful menu pictures, a large ice cream cone graphic, and partial “ICE CREAM” lettering. The main young man turns back and gestures toward the truck, pointing as if calling attention to it, while still holding his Dr Pepper can. The vendor is then seen smiling broadly, and a young girl with long curly hair licks a vanilla ice cream cone, her face filling the scene as she smiles around the treat. A close view of the Dr Pepper can shows it swinging beside the main man’s dark pants as he walks; the red can and bold white “Dr Pepper” lettering are prominent. He passes beneath fire escapes, smiling and looking comfortable in the street setting. An older white man wearing a black hat and light shirt sits outside a shuttered storefront in a folding chair, holding an open newspaper. He turns with a friendly smile toward the passing activity. On another corner, an elderly white woman with short white hair stands with a cane near a small shop. She wears glasses, a light patterned top, a dark skirt, a black cardigan draped over her shoulders, and white shoes. Red Dr Pepper crates or a display stand are visible near the shop entrance behind her. The young man bends down warmly toward her, and they touch cheeks in a friendly greeting. She smiles and looks up at him while holding her cane for support. He straightens, still smiling, and continues on as she watches him. A group of older men are gathered around what appears to be a sidewalk game. One elderly white man with white hair, glasses, and a gray polo shirt crouches low and reaches forward as if rolling or tossing a small object. Other older men stand nearby watching; one white-haired man in a blue-gray T-shirt holds a red Dr Pepper can. The men react animatedly, raising hands and gesturing, as if cheering or commenting on the play. The young man walks on through a crowded sidewalk, smiling as people pass blurred in the foreground. He bends down to greet a small Black child wearing a white sleeveless top and loose gray-green pants. He wraps his hands around the child’s waist, lifts the child up, and settles the child onto his shoulders. The child’s legs spread around his neck as he rises, creating a playful, affectionate moment in the middle of the busy street. A taxi driver wearing a dark turban and a beard smiles from the open window of a yellow cab, his arm resting on the door. Pedestrians briefly pass between him and the viewer, then he is visible again, still smiling toward the street. The final image centers on a Black woman carrying a young Black girl on her shoulders in a crowded, softly blurred city background. The woman wears a dark head covering and a sleeveless gray-green top, and she drinks from a red Dr Pepper can. The child, sitting high above her, has her hair gathered into a high puff and smiles while holding onto the woman’s head. To the upper right, a glossy blue-green globe graphic appears and changes into a circular Dr Pepper logo. The red Dr Pepper script sits in the middle, surrounded by the visible slogan text “MAKES THE WORLD TASTE BETTER.” Near the lower right, small white text reads “drpepper.com.”

At night on a wet city street, a corner storefront glows with green and red neon and a sign with Chinese characters. Pedestrians move along the sidewalk under the awnings while the slick pavement reflects the lights. In the foreground, a round manhole sits open in the street. A light-skinned, male-presenting worker in a yellow hard hat and dark work jacket rises up through the manhole, holding a mobile phone to his ear. He wears dark-framed glasses and a rectangular name patch on his chest. Only his upper body is visible above street level as he looks forward, listens, and speaks into the phone, then settles into a small, satisfied smile while people continue walking behind him. The same bespectacled man appears next in a swampy wooded area, now wearing gray chest waders over a dark shirt. He holds the phone to his ear with one hand while trudging through shallow water among tree trunks and exposed roots. He lifts his knees high to step through the mud and water, then reaches out with his free hand to steady himself against a narrow tree trunk. He pauses there, standing knee-deep in the wet ground, still listening and talking on the phone, surrounded by muted greens and browns of the marsh. The scene changes to a bright office corridor lined with gray cubicles. A professional-looking woman in a tan skirt suit walks down the aisle toward the front, carrying a stack of folders and a black briefcase. As she passes out of the way, the same man is revealed seated in an office chair in the middle of the aisle, still wearing his dark work jacket and glasses, phone pressed to his ear. A small line of white legal text runs along the bottom of the image, too small to read clearly here. Behind him, office workers stand and talk near a bright window, and an older beige computer monitor sits in one cubicle. The man sits upright, calm and focused, then slowly turns and rolls the chair sideways while continuing his call. He is then seen outdoors in warm sunlight beside tall reeds or cane plants, with muddy water and a large dark piece of equipment or vehicle in the background. In close view, he holds a silver-and-black mobile phone to his ear and looks slightly off to the side through his black glasses. The golden light catches his face and the plants around him. He remains intent on the call, his expression neutral and testing, then begins to move out of the reeds. In a dry desert setting, he steps into view in front of reddish rock formations, a Joshua tree, and a small outdoor campsite or activity area with people and gear in the background. The sky is clear blue. He wears the dark Verizon-style work jacket with a rectangular patch and continues holding the phone to his ear. He walks a few paces, facing forward, speaking and listening, while the desert rocks fill the background. The environment shifts to a cold, dark, wintry-looking place. The man is bundled in a heavy black parka with a large fur-trimmed hood pulled around his face. His black-framed glasses are still visible, and a rectangular patch is sewn on the front of the coat. A phone or headset rests at his ear, partly hidden by the hood and glove. He looks straight ahead, then glances slightly upward and to the side, appearing alert and still engaged in the same phone test despite the extreme cold suggested by the heavy clothing and dim, icy-looking background. A long, open road or bridge appears at sunset, lined on the right by a repeating row of tall utility poles that recede into the distance. The man is now a small figure walking away down the road, silhouetted against orange light near the horizon and darker clouds above. Over this scene, the Verizon Wireless logo fades in large across the center: white lowercase “verizon” with the red checkmark accent above it and the word “wireless” in smaller white letters to the right. The background darkens slightly behind the logo while the distant figure continues to stand or walk along the road. After the logo, the man appears on a city sidewalk outside a storefront. He is in the left foreground, still on his phone, facing a smiling young woman with long dark hair who wears a red top with white stripes on the sleeves and holds a snowboard or skateboard-like board against her hip. Another young woman in a green top stands behind them near the doorway, watching. On the right, a bald man crouches or sits low, also holding a phone to his ear. Yellow flyers or stickers are posted in vertical rows on the doorframe and window area. The main man gestures with his free hand while talking, then steps closer to the smiling woman, turning partly away so the back of his dark jacket is visible, with white Verizon Wireless lettering across it.

A glossy red sports car fills the screen in extreme close detail against a dark background. Its side window and rear quarter panel are visible, with red seats inside and a white rectangular reflection or paper-like shape catching the light through the glass. A large red door panel or upward-opening body section rises above the cabin, emphasizing the car’s sculpted, exotic shape. The view glides across the car’s red bodywork, showing the curved roofline, black glass, vents, and smooth reflections on the paint. The game title appears over racing imagery: bold, slanted white letters spell “MIDNIGHT CLUB II,” with large white Asian characters above and to the left. Behind the text, a teal-green car body fills the right side, while a blurred night street and another orange car sit to the left, suggesting speed and city racing. The title remains centered across the shiny car surface for several moments. The red sports car returns in a close side view, now focused on the front wheel, fender, and door. The silver multi-spoke rim sits under a rounded wheel arch, and a small chrome side vent or intake glints near the lower body. The red paint is highly polished, reflecting soft light as the car’s contours dominate the image. The perspective shifts inside a moving car, looking out through dark window pillars at a nighttime city. Bright yellow-lit building windows streak past. An orange sports car races alongside outside the passenger window, visible in pieces as it passes behind the dark interior frame and side mirror. It drops back into the distance on an elevated road lined with barriers and surrounded by tall buildings. A metallic Rockstar-style emblem appears on a yellow surface: a rounded square badge with a gold “R” and a star at the lower right, rendered like a chrome-and-gold logo. The badge recedes slightly, centered on the yellow background. Headlights flare in the darkness as cars approach head-on. Then the city opens into a wide skyline view: tall modern buildings, elevated highways, and a bright horizon. The scene darkens rapidly into night, and white and red light trails curve along the roads between the buildings, giving the impression of traffic and high speed through an urban downtown. A purple classic muscle car with bright round headlights fills the foreground from a low angle. The front bumper is chrome, the front wheel has a shiny deep-dish rim, and yellow flame graphics lick back along the purple side panel. The car looks heavy and customized, with an aggressive stance. From inside another car, a green-and-white racing car slides sideways across a narrow nighttime street in front of a metal fence and stone buildings. Its headlights throw a bright beam through tire smoke. The green lower body and white upper body are visible as it drifts, wheels angled, smoke curling around the car and across the pavement. Two cars are then seen from behind, side by side, their red taillights glowing through smoky air as they accelerate down a city street. The left car is yellow or orange; the right car is darker red. Both appear to be racing away into the night. A motorcycle appears briefly, front wheel lifted high in a wheelie. Its headlight shines toward the viewer, and the rider is mostly a dark silhouette in black gear, leaning back as the bike rears up near parked cars on a dim street. A silver or gray sports car charges forward at night with icy blue headlights. Its hood has dark vents and a central stripe or raised line, and the windshield reflects orange vertical lights from buildings overhead. The car’s front end dominates the scene as it speeds along empty streets. On a cobblestone street at night, a car crests or scrapes along the uneven road, throwing orange sparks from underneath. The headlights glare brightly, and the car flashes past from left to right, leaving sparks scattered over the stones. Another set of headlights follows from the distance up the same street. Police imagery follows: a dark police car or patrol vehicle approaches with bright headlights and a red-and-blue light bar on top. The image becomes blurred with blue and red flashes, then shifts to a dark aerial view where a purple-white searchlight beam cuts down through the night. A car drifts beneath tall bridge supports or street structures, leaving a plume of smoke as the searchlight illuminates the road. A high, exterior view looks through a grid of vertical building bars or window frames at cars racing along a multi-level ramp or elevated roadway inside an urban structure. Headlights flare behind the bars, and a light blue car and an orange car appear close together. The view pulls wider to show them exiting toward a city intersection below, where another car with headlights crosses the street. On a foggy street, headlights glow through haze near old buildings and lampposts. A red sports car sweeps across the foreground from right to left, its rear lights and curved body blurred by speed. Light streaks and smoke make the passing cars hard-edged and ghostly, as if they are sliding through mist. A dark purple sports car follows in close detail. Bright headlights shine from the front, then the view tracks along the side: large black wheels, low bodywork, and a raised rear wing. Smoke clings around the tires and lower panels as the car glides past on a paved road. An orange sports car is shown from behind and low to the ground, racing down a city street between tall buildings. Its right taillight glows red, its rear wing rises high, and the body reflects the blue-gray street and building lights. White lane lines stretch ahead. A small ESRB rating icon appears at the lower left, showing a large “T” for Teen. The car continues forward through the city canyon as neon and window reflections slide across its paint. A purple muscle car with flame decals returns, sliding around a corner near a building with bright turquoise horizontal neon bands. Smoke billows heavily from the rear tires. The car has a black hood or roof, chrome trim, and a prominent engine blower protruding through the hood. The “T” rating icon remains at the lower left as the car moves across the scene and exits, leaving a cloud of smoke behind. The action shifts to a rain-slicked, neon-lit city intersection. Dark cars streak across the wet road, their silhouettes cutting in front of bright white signs and traffic lights. Reflections shimmer on the pavement. Headlights approach in a cluster, growing brighter and more blurred among colorful billboards. A large blue sign with the word “club” is visible in the background as smoke or spray washes across the street. Large white title letters begin to rush forward over the racing scene. The background remains a bright, wet nighttime avenue with billboards and headlights, while the slanted metallic letters assemble across the center. The final title locks into place: white Asian characters above the bold italic words “MIDNIGHT CLUB II.” The ESRB “T” for Teen rating icon sits at the lower left, and the title remains over the blurred neon city backdrop.

The commercial opens on an open-air boat or ferry deck in bright daylight. Miss Piggy and Kermit the Frog stand near a railing with the Statue of Liberty centered in the distance behind them against a clear blue sky. Miss Piggy is dressed glamorously in a leopard-print fur hat and matching coat, with long blonde hair and a pearl necklace. She faces Kermit, her mouth opening and closing as if speaking, while Kermit, green with his pointed collar, turns his large eyes toward her and then toward the skyline. A small Mastercard logo appears at the lower right of the image. As they continue looking at each other and at the statue, white text begins to appear at the lower left: “trip…” Kermit stands with one hand at his side, while Miss Piggy tilts her head and looks pleased. Fozzie Bear, an orange-brown furry bear wearing his familiar brown hat, steps in from the right, looming close in the foreground and facing them. More Muppet characters crowd in around Miss Piggy and Kermit on the deck, filling the space. The text expands to “trip…for eight:” and then “trip…for eight: free.” The group becomes lively and packed together: Sam the Eagle, tall and blue-gray with a stern expression, stands at the left; Animal, with wild red hair and a wide open mouth, pops up near the center; other Muppets press in around Kermit and Miss Piggy, their faces overlapping in a cheerful cluster. Colorful triangular pennant flags hang above them, and the Statue of Liberty remains visible between the characters in the background. The setting changes to a city sidewalk lined with stone buildings. Miss Piggy now walks in a white, fashion-forward outfit: a large white hat, white oval sunglasses, and a white coat with fluffy fur trim at the shoulders. She moves among human pedestrians dressed in dark city clothing. Her posture is upright and confident, and her head turns slightly as if leading the way. Behind and around her, people pass by on the busy street. As Miss Piggy moves out of view, a large collection of shopping bags and stacked gift boxes fills the sidewalk. The packages are in pastel and bright colors—pink, cream, green, white, and multicolored—with ribbons and handles. The white lower-left text reads “shopping:” and then changes to “shopping: free.” Muppet characters are partly hidden by the tall piles of bags and boxes. Fozzie’s orange face appears near the center behind the packages, and Kermit peeks in from the right, looking up from beside a cluster of bags. The packages are so numerous that they obscure much of the group, suggesting an exaggerated shopping spree. A wider city street appears in full daylight, with tall buildings on both sides, American flags hanging from facades, and a bus stopped in the distance. Crowds of pedestrians cross the street, while yellow taxis and dark cars line the foreground and sides. The group of Muppets and shoppers is visible on the right side amid the flow of people and traffic, still surrounded by shopping bags. The text “shopping: free” remains at the lower left. The scene moves to nighttime outside a theater. Kermit stands in front of a lit marquee with a sign reading “THE PRODUCERS,” with smaller text above that appears to reference Mel Brooks. Warm theater lights glow along the canopy and building facade. Kermit is dressed formally in a black suit or tuxedo with a white shirt and black tie. He looks upward toward the sign and then faces forward, appearing ready for an evening out. White text at the lower left reads “entertainment.” Inside a warmly lit restaurant or supper-club setting, the Muppets sit together around tables with glasses, candles, and plates. The room has dark wood tones and a polished, upscale atmosphere. In the foreground, Miss Piggy and Kermit sit close together, leaning cheek to cheek. Miss Piggy, now in a soft pink-and-white look with long blonde hair, wraps herself affectionately near Kermit, who sits beside her with a relaxed smile. Behind them, Fozzie, Animal, Sam the Eagle, and other Muppets gather at the table, some facing forward and others turned toward one another. At the right, an older male waiter in a black vest, white shirt, and bow tie stands holding a small notepad or check folder, observing the group. White text across the lower left reads, “people who make you feel warm and fuzzy:” and then adds “priceless.” The final images show the group inside a yellow taxi at night. The Muppets are crowded into the back seat, visible through the taxi’s side windows; Animal’s red hair, Kermit’s green face, and other familiar figures appear in the cramped interior. Fine-print legal text runs along the bottom of the screen. Over the taxi window and yellow body, the word “Priceless” appears in a white handwritten script, tying the busy city outing and time with friends back to the Mastercard “Priceless” theme.

The images are in stark black and white. A large, formal boardroom appears, with a long glossy conference table stretching toward the viewer and rows of empty leather chairs along both sides. The walls are wood-paneled, the ceiling is dark with small recessed lights, and the atmosphere is cold and corporate. Three male-presenting executives in dark suits and ties sit far apart around the table, their reflections visible on the polished surface. The view moves among the men. An older man with swept-back white hair sits in profile, while a thinner, balding middle-aged man in a suit sits farther down the table, looking forward with a controlled, serious expression. Another white-haired older executive is shown seated alone near the end of the table, facing across it as if speaking or listening during a business meeting. Then the visual tone turns unnatural. The white-haired executive suddenly jerks and bends forward, and another suited man seems to lunge or emerge from his body, as if a second executive is being produced out of him. The first man leans back with his head tilted upward while the emerging man plants his hands on the table and pushes himself forward. The same disturbing pattern continues: the balding man’s face tightens, his head and shoulders blur and contort, and his body appears to split or transform into another suited businessman. The boardroom begins filling with more male-presenting executives in dark suits. Some stand, some sit, and others are caught mid-lurch, leaning backward or forward as if more men are being generated from them. Their faces are mostly stern, strained, or blank. Around the conference table, the figures multiply quickly, crowding the once-empty room. Several men stand shoulder to shoulder near the walls; others turn their heads or stare across the room. One white-haired man steps forward through the crowd, while behind him another man appears to be forced backward by the arrival of yet another suited figure. The glossy table now reflects the dense cluster of bodies. The room becomes packed with businessmen. A balding man stands in the center looking alert and tense, surrounded by many similar men in suits. In the background and along the sides, more executives keep appearing and shifting, creating the impression of unchecked growth inside the corporate space. The scene changes to the outside of a glass-walled office or conference room. Behind the tall window panels, a large crowd of suited men presses close together, filling the room from side to side. Their hands and faces are visible through the glass. The glass then becomes covered with a speckled, cloudy pattern, obscuring the men behind it until they look like a pale, grainy mass. From above, groups of dark-suited figures move across city pavement. Seen from high overhead, the men look small and numerous, with long shadows stretching beside them. They stream and cluster together in an urban street grid between tall buildings. The crowd becomes a dense, dark, rounded mass moving through an intersection, like a swarm. That crowded mass is then visually overlaid inside a medical chest X-ray. The ribs and lungs fill the screen in high-contrast black and white, and the clustered crowd appears as a dark, spreading spot inside one lung, resembling a tumor or diseased area. The X-ray image becomes clearer and steadier, showing the rib cage, spine, and both lungs, with the abnormal cloudy patch on the viewer’s right side of the chest image. Across the lower center of the X-ray, black text appears and becomes readable: “As they continue to grow, we continue to die.” The final image holds on the X-ray with that message, visually connecting the multiplying corporate figures to disease in the lungs.

A glossy red circular button sits alone on a pale grey surface, like a large control button set into a smooth panel. It changes into a shiny blue button with a silver rim and a yellow triangular play symbol in the centre, set against a vivid blue background with faint watery streaks and floating digital shapes. The yellow play triangle grows until it fills the view, becoming a bright gateway into an abstract orange and gold space filled with glowing rings, bubbles, and streaks of light. Within this warm, glowing environment, a small computer-window image appears, then gives way to close, warmly lit faces. A smiling young woman with short dark hair looks directly forward, while a man with facial hair leans in behind her, nuzzling close at her shoulder. Both appear relaxed and happy. A little blond girl then fills the screen, smiling directly outward in bright sunlight, her hair falling across her forehead and her light patterned top visible at the edges. The mood turns more energetic as a young man with dark hair, black rectangular glasses, a bright blue shirt, tie, and dark trousers poses outside a striking yellow building. He carries a dark shoulder bag and makes playful, animated gestures, lifting one knee and pointing as if dancing or celebrating in front of the building’s large round yellow architectural feature. Inside what appears to be a small aircraft, a woman in a blue skydiving suit and yellow goggles sits in front of a blond instructor wearing dark sunglasses. The instructor gives a thumbs-up from behind her, and she smiles broadly. A blue graphic streak sweeps along the bottom with the white text “push FASTER.” A handheld or small screen is then shown displaying the same skydiving scene, as if the action is being watched or shared through a digital device. The orange digital background returns with a floating web browser-style page. The page has a purple bar across the top with Telocity branding at the upper right and a section labelled “e-mail.” On the right side of the message, large readable text says, “Hey kids, See what I did! Love, Grammy.” On the left, a photo shows the woman skydiving with her instructor, arms spread in freefall against a blue sky, visually matching the earlier plane scene. Another web page floats in the same glowing orange space. It is a green travel page with Telocity branding at the top right. A left column reads “Kato Falls,” and the main area shows moving scenic imagery of rushing water, rocks, and green foliage. The page includes a “Travel” heading and a “Locator” area, suggesting destination browsing. The travel imagery then becomes full-screen: a woman in outdoor clothes with a backpack stands in a lush, rocky forest gorge before a tall waterfall. She stretches both arms outward and lifts her face toward the falling water, surrounded by deep greens and cool blue light. The young man with black glasses reappears in a city street lined with tall buildings. He smiles broadly into the foreground. A blue streak crosses the lower part of the image, and large white text appears: “push COOLER.” The exaggerated close view makes his grin and glasses prominent, with skyscraper facades rising behind him. Back in the orange digital space, a shopping page spins into view. It has a purple-blue layout with Telocity branding at the top right, a section labelled “Shop,” and a product category that reads “scooters.” In the centre, a small scooter is displayed inside a large orange circular frame. On the right, bold white text says “BUY NOW,” next to a round orange button. The scooter image enlarges and rotates slightly within the page, with navigation arrows visible near the bottom. The commercial then shows the scooter in real life: a low, close view of a yellow kick scooter rolling along a city street beside parked cars. A person’s black shoe rests on the scooter deck as the front wheel moves past the camera. The same young man in the blue shirt, dark vest, and black glasses appears riding or moving forward, smiling as he passes through a softly blurred urban background. A quick series of joyful lifestyle images follows. A young boy smiles in cool blue light, his face close and bright against a dark background. A young woman in a red top smiles outdoors beneath a vivid blue sky, her hair blown back. At a beach at sunset, several people run across wet sand toward the water; a yellow-and-white surfboard lies in the foreground, and the sky glows pink, orange, and purple. A Black woman laughs with her head tilted back, lit in deep blue tones against a dark, leafy background. A man in a white T-shirt and sunglasses appears suspended midair against a deep blue sky, arms spread wide beside a curved yellow surface, suggesting an extreme-sport or airborne moment. The visuals shift to a bright orange offer screen. Large white text appears: “FREE Activation.” Fine print along the bottom is small but partially readable, mentioning limited service availability, monthly service fees and shipping, and a limited-time offer with details on the web site. The offer expands to read “FREE Activation” and “No Annual Contract” in large white lettering over the orange glow. A blue and yellow swoosh sweeps across the offer screen, revealing the website address “www.telocity.com.” The commercial ends on a glossy blue background with soft circular ripples and bubbles. The white Telocity logo appears in the centre, accented by a yellow swoosh around the final letters. A yellow line streaks beneath the logo as the brand mark remains prominent on the blue field.

A woman in a white long-sleeved blouse and dark pants stands in a small laundry room beside a washer or work surface. Shelves on the left hold household bottles and containers, and a window is centered behind her. She lifts a large white sheet or piece of laundry from a basket or pile, raising it above her head and then gathering it in her arms. The room has a clean, bright, slightly silvery look, with white laundry glowing strongly in the light. The scene moves outside to the front of a city townhouse with stone steps, an arched doorway, and tall windows with curtains. The same woman steps out carrying a large woven laundry basket filled with folded and loose clothes. From above, a small silver hatchback car is parked at the curb below the steps. She brings the basket toward the car, then sets it on top of the car roof. The basket sits upright on the roof, packed with white laundry, with a blue garment hanging over one side and a light green cloth visible on the other. She opens the driver’s door and gets in, leaving the basket perched on the roof as if it is cargo for a trip. The silver car drives through the city with the wicker basket still on top. Tall buildings rise against a blue sky with large white clouds. The car passes along urban streets and under or near concrete overpasses, then crosses a bridge toward a downtown skyline. The basket remains centered on the roof, its handle arched upward and the light-colored laundry visible above the rim. The car continues out of the city into a residential neighborhood with trees and houses, then into open countryside. A black-and-white cow stands beside a fence as the car passes on a rural road, and another close view shows the cow’s head near the fence, looking toward the road. The car travels along dusty country lanes and through rolling green hills under a vivid blue sky. The landscape opens wide, with grassy fields, low hills, scattered trees, and a pale dirt road winding through the scene. Eventually the woman stands under the shade of a tree, holding the full woven laundry basket at her waist, facing a broad, sunlit meadow. A clothesline stretches across the field, and the setting feels open and breezy. Large white sheets and a green sheet hang from the line, billowing outward in the wind. The fabric fills much of the view at times, rippling and swelling like sails, with the grassy field and blue sky visible between the hanging pieces. The billowing white fabric gives way to a close view of an orange Tide detergent bottle. The label shows a blue sky and white sheet graphic, with visible text reading “NEW Scent!” above the large Tide logo. As the full bottle comes into view, it has a blue cap, a built-in handle on the right, and the front label reads “Tide Clean Breeze.” It stands in front of a bright window with blue sky and clouds outside. Back in the countryside, the woman holds the woven basket full of neatly folded white laundry. She lowers her gaze toward the clean clothes, then looks up and smiles softly. Behind her are green grass, trees, and the clothesline. The car is then seen again on the rural road, driving away across the rolling landscape with the basket still on its roof. The final product display places the orange Tide Clean Breeze bottle in tall grass against the same blue-sky countryside background. A second, pale bottle with a blue cap stands slightly behind it, branded “Downy.” At the bottom of the screen, white text reads “www.tide.com.”

A silver four-door Kia Spectra drives through a bright downtown street lined with tall glass and concrete office buildings. Sunlight flares between the buildings, reflecting off the car’s hood and windshield. The sedan is shown from the front and front-left side as it travels along a wide, mostly empty multi-lane road with white lane markings and guardrails along the sidewalk. Inside the car, a close-up shows a light-skinned hand sliding a compact disc into a dark dashboard CD player. Only the hand, the silver disc, and part of the black stereo face are visible, suggesting the driver is using the audio system. The car continues through the city, now seen from behind and slightly to the left as it moves along an elevated-looking roadway past modern buildings. White on-screen feature text appears near the lower right and lower left in stages: “power locks,” “power windows,” “power mirrors,” and “air conditioning.” The sedan keeps rolling forward, its rear lights and rounded trunk visible. A small white disclaimer then appears across the bottom: “Up to $4,000 cash back, including $1,000 owner loyalty bonus and $500 military bonus,” while the car crosses broad white crosswalk stripes and continues down the road. The setting shifts to a more shaded concrete area, like an underpass or tunnel entrance. The same silver sedan drives along a smooth roadway beside tall concrete walls. White text at the bottom reads, “10 year / 100,000 mile limited powertrain warranty.” The car passes from brighter light into shadow, then back toward light, shown from the side and rear as it follows the road beside the walls. Back in the city, the Spectra cruises past more high-rise buildings and roadside barriers. The car is again shown from the front-left side, its rounded headlights, black grille, silver body, and compact sedan shape clearly visible. The windows look darkly tinted, and no occupants are clearly distinguishable. A very close view of the front grille fills much of the screen. The oval Kia badge sits centered in a black grille, surrounded by the silver front bodywork. Buildings slide past in the background as the car moves, emphasizing the badge and front end. The car then faces forward in a darker urban underpass-like space. It approaches head-on, centered against a shadowed concrete background. Fine-print text appears along the bottom, with a larger line reading “GSX model shown costs extra.” More small comparison and pricing disclaimer text stretches across the lower portion. Above the car, bold white text appears: “The 2003 Kia Spectra.” A second line is added beneath it: “$2,200 less than Honda Civic.” The car continues moving forward slowly, its headlights and amber side marker lights visible, the hood reflecting bright light while the background remains dark. The final screen is a black information card. At the top is the Kia logo with the slogan “Make every mile count.” Large centered white text reads: “Starting at $8,235 after $4,000 cash back including $1,000 owner loyalty bonus and $500 military bonus.” Beneath that, it says, “Offer ends soon.” A block of small fine print fills the bottom, listing pricing conditions, incentives, exclusions, and a Kia website for details.

The commercial opens in a blue-gray wash of stormy water and rain, with the view partly obscured by streaks and spray. A blonde adult woman appears in a rainy urban setting, her hair loose and damp-looking, wearing a dark coat over a light top. She holds a dark shoe above her head like a small shelter, its pale heel or sole catching the light, while she looks forward with a composed, slightly determined expression. A man’s face then appears in close view, half hidden in shadow and rain-patterned light; only one side of his older, weathered face is clearly lit, giving him a serious, concentrated look. Inside a car, rain beads across the windshield as the wipers sweep back and forth. A hand rests on the steering wheel, where the Volvo emblem is visible, and the dashboard and air vents fill the foreground. Through the wet glass, blurred buildings and a storefront pass by outside. The gray Volvo wagon is then seen from the front on a slick city street, headlights and fog lights glowing in the rain. Its driver’s door is open beside a row of buildings, and the wet pavement reflects the lights. The setting shifts to winding, mountainous roads in heavy rain. The Volvo wagon moves around a sharp curve bordered by metal guardrails and dark, wooded slopes. Water sprays from the tires as the car follows the bend. Soon it is shown on an open road under a low, stormy sky, the silver-gray wagon advancing steadily with its headlights on, roof rails visible along the top, and mist rising from the wet surface. Inside, the same blonde woman sits in the front passenger seat, wearing a dark jacket and white shirt. Beside her, an adult man with short light hair drives, dressed in a light blue shirt with a tie. The woman’s face is calm and observant as she looks upward and out, while the driver keeps his attention on the road. The car continues through open, rugged country near water, sending up spray as it moves across a bleak landscape of low hills and reeds. For a moment the imagery becomes dark and underwater-looking, with indistinct shapes and pale highlights moving through bluish water. The car then appears high above a rough coastline, traveling along a curving road beside churning surf, rocky shorelines, and dark cliffs. It drives toward the viewer along a narrow coastal road, rain and sea spray blowing across the scene. Waves crash violently against black rocks, exploding into white foam. The Volvo pushes through sheets of water, its headlights bright against the blue-gray storm. A side view shows the wagon passing through heavy spray, the body partly swallowed by mist. The water briefly fills the whole view, then the rear of the car appears close up: red tail lamps glowing through rain droplets on the silver bodywork, suggesting the car has slowed or stopped. Inside again, the woman’s face is lit by wavering, rain-streaked light. Her expression is serious and focused as she looks forward. On the wet road ahead, a small turtle sits low in the foreground, its domed shell slick with rain. The Volvo is visible behind it with headlights on, stopped or approaching slowly at a distance. A close view of the turtle shows its patterned head and shell, wet and mottled, as it extends its head slightly from under the shell. Through the windshield, the woman and the male driver sit side by side. Rain and reflections soften their faces. The woman looks ahead, then turns toward the driver, while he remains at the wheel in his light shirt and tie. After that, the man is seen outside in the stormy coastal environment, wet and moving quickly. His blue shirt clings slightly, his tie hangs loose, and he looks around as he runs. From a wider view, the Volvo’s front corner fills the left side of the scene while the man runs away in the distance across a rocky shoreline near the water. Waves continue to surge around dark rocks. Then, underwater, a sea turtle swims through blue-green water above a rocky seabed. Its flippers paddle slowly and steadily as it moves across the frame, now free in the ocean. The commercial ends on a wide, gray seascape: a low rocky breakwater stretches across the bottom, with heavy clouds and a pale horizon beyond.

The commercial begins in a bright, stylized suburban neighborhood. A silver sedan drives straight toward the viewer along a dark, freshly marked road, centered over double white lines. On both sides are neat sidewalks, lawns, small houses, mailboxes, and vivid red-orange trees, with snow-capped mountains rising in the distance under a blue-green sky. The scene has a polished, miniature-model look, with saturated colors and very clean lines. The view pulls back to show the silver car continuing down the middle of the quiet residential street. Other vehicles appear nearby: a dark SUV on the left side of the road and a red sports car on the right. The setting remains orderly and scenic, with rows of houses, bright autumn trees, and mountains beyond the neighborhood. Inside the silver car, a light-skinned adult man drives. He appears to be in his thirties or forties, with short dark hair, wearing a dark long-sleeved top. He sits upright in the driver’s seat, both hands on the steering wheel, looking forward with a calm, focused expression. The car interior is dark, with a broad dashboard and empty passenger seat visible. Back outside, the silver sedan is seen from behind as it continues away down the center of the road. The residential area gives way to a dramatic mountain route. A snowy rocky peak fills the foreground, and beyond it a curving road hugs a steep cliff. Tall gray rock walls, evergreen trees, pink-orange foliage, and a waterfall create a fantasy mountain landscape. The road runs along a high viaduct with stone arches, and small cars trace the curve around the mountainside. The cars then travel beneath a dense canopy of brilliant red, pink, and orange trees. The silver sedan remains in the center, flanked by a dark SUV on the left and a red coupe on the right. Fallen leaves speckle the road as the three vehicles drive close together. In the red car’s side mirror, the silver sedan and the dark SUV are reflected behind it, framed by the mirror’s black border and the red bodywork of the car. The route opens onto a high cliff road with sweeping mountain views. Cars wind along a narrow elevated roadway wrapped around a massive gray rock face, with a deep valley and more autumn-colored trees below. A close view of the red sports car’s front end shows its low bumper and headlights as it rolls over the dark road. The vehicles approach a tunnel entrance built into the mountain, where three arched openings sit beneath digital overhead signs. The signs display mileage numbers: “15000,” “7500,” and “5000,” each above a separate tunnel lane. Above another three-arch tunnel, three giant Mobil oil bottles stand like roadside monuments. From left to right, the bottles have different cap and label colors: a red-capped Mobil bottle labeled with “5000,” a blue-capped Mobil bottle labeled with “7500,” and a larger bottle with a gold cap and a black-and-gold Mobil label associated with extended performance. The silver sedan, the dark SUV, and the red coupe drive toward and beneath these oversized product bottles, which are mounted against the rocky mountain backdrop and framed by bright autumn trees. A side view shows the vehicles moving along the highway, with the grille of the dark SUV large in the foreground and the silver sedan and red coupe passing alongside. The landscape stays vivid and artificial-looking, with guardrails, pink trees, blue sky, and distant mountains. A large roadside billboard appears next. On it, a shiny metallic engine assembly is displayed against a graphic background of bold pink and pale blue shapes. The engine parts slide across the billboard image, showing pistons and cylindrical components in reflective chrome, visually suggesting internal engine parts being protected. The road continues past modern roadside structures built into cliffs, with the billboard standing high on a pole beside the elevated highway. The scenery then shifts to a lake surrounded by mountains and colorful trees. A huge red-capped Mobil bottle stands on the far shore like a statue, while cars continue along a road behind it. As the view widens, three oversized Mobil oil bottles are arranged across the landscape: the blue-capped “7500” bottle on the left, the red-capped “5000” bottle in the center background, and the gold-capped extended-performance bottle on the right, set on rocky outcrops around the water. A white speedboat or watercraft cuts across the lake, leaving a pale wake. Cars pass along the road in the foreground as the bottles remain prominent against the mountain scenery. From high above, the entire route is revealed as a sprawling, looping road system winding through forests, mountains, waterfalls, a blue lake, and small clusters of houses. The road curves repeatedly like a long test track, with multiple lanes and sweeping bends, emphasizing distance and endurance across varied terrain. The final product display appears on a clean white background. Three Mobil oil bottles stand together: a red-capped Mobil 5000 bottle on the left, a larger gold-capped Mobil 1 extended-performance-style bottle in the center, and a blue-capped Mobil 7500 bottle on the right. Beneath them is small text reading “Official Lubricant of” followed by the NASCAR logo. The commercial ends on a simple white screen with the Mobil logo in large teal letters and a red “o,” and the website “mobiloil.com” centered below.

On a busy city sidewalk outside a modern glass-fronted building, a young woman with shoulder-length brown hair stands at an outdoor flower stall. She wears a pale yellow-green dress under a black cardigan and smiles as she looks over bright bunches of pink and red flowers. On the display table beside her are a black handbag and a yellow Post Honey-Comb cereal box partly tucked into a white shopping bag. A young man in a black knit cap, red plaid shirt, dark gloves, and loose dark pants rushes in from behind her. He grabs the black handbag and the Honey-Comb box and bolts down the sidewalk. The woman’s expression changes to alarm; she turns, leans forward, and points after him. The thief sprints past benches outside the building, clutching the bright yellow cereal box against his chest. Several kids sit nearby. One blond boy, about early teen age, wears a red-and-black padded vest, elbow pads, wrist guards, and skater clothes, with a skateboard beside him. He looks up sharply, eyes widening in surprise. His face fills the view as he reacts with exaggerated amazement, then an animated green thought bubble appears above him, filled with giant golden Honey-Comb cereal pieces glistening with honey. He pulls on a yellow helmet decorated with dark spots and flame-like markings, as if inspired into action. The boy is suddenly represented as a small, wild-looking, furry cartoon character: yellow-orange shaggy fur, huge round eyes, a long pink nose and cheeks, black gloves, protective pads, and the same yellow helmet. He rides a skateboard down the sidewalk near parked bicycles and a flight of building steps. Arms out for balance, he gains speed, pops off the board, and leaps high, grinning broadly before landing back down in a chaotic slide. The thief, still hugging the Honey-Comb box, runs through a busier shopping area and looks back over his shoulder with a nervous grin. The furry skater pursues him along the sidewalk past stacks of newspapers. As the creature rushes through, the piles of papers fly apart, pages flipping and scattering across the pavement. Nearby dogs on leashes react and lunge; a large black-and-white dog fills the view as it jumps forward, while a smaller white dog stands beside it. Traffic passes in front of storefronts with red and green awnings. Water suddenly erupts in a tall white spray beside the street, and another column of golden cereal-like pieces or debris showers upward near a shop window, adding to the commotion. The thief pauses and turns his head, startled, then keeps running with the yellow box tight against his side. The chase continues past a green awning marked “K MARKET.” A large white animal figure or costume-like shape tumbles through the scene, and pedestrians in suits and casual clothes turn to watch. Ahead, two movers in blue coveralls are pushing a large black upright piano on a wheeled dolly along the sidewalk. The chaos barrels into them: the piano is struck or tipped, its wooden interior and strings exposed. A burst of dust and splinters fills the air. The furry skater shoots through the wreckage, then reappears with black-and-white piano keys comically jammed across his mouth like oversized teeth. He freezes for a beat with wide eyes and raised hands, looking dazed but still eager. The thief keeps moving, clutching the Honey-Comb box. He runs past a construction area where orange-and-white striped barriers and steam mark an open manhole. A construction worker in a yellow hard hat and reflective vest pushes up the round manhole cover from below. The thief passes over the opening, and the furry skater uses the raised cover like a ramp. The little creature is launched upward, flying on his skateboard against a backdrop of tall city buildings and blue sky. He sails between skyscrapers, crouched low over the board, mouth open in excitement. From above, the thief is seen running along the sidewalk while the woman in the pale dress follows behind him. He looks upward, still holding the cereal box and black handbag, as pieces of debris streak down around him. Then the furry skater drops from above and lands on the thief’s back. The thief lurches forward, face strained, while the creature clings to him triumphantly, waving its arms and grinning. The chase ends with the thief bent over under the furry character’s weight, the Honey-Comb box still visible against his red plaid shirt, and the woman close behind. The commercial shifts to a product display on a table outdoors. A large yellow Post Honey-Comb cereal box stands behind a white bowl filled with the cereal’s round, honeycomb-shaped pieces. Around it are breakfast items: a glass of orange juice, a clear pitcher of milk, toast on a plate, and sliced fruit including kiwi and melon. The box front shows the bold blue words “Honey-Comb.” At the end, the scene returns to the building steps. The blond skater boy sits relaxed on the stoop, no longer the furry character, eating Honey-Comb from a blue bowl with a spoon. He wears his red-and-black skater outfit with pads, and his yellow helmet and skateboard rest nearby; the skateboard has a flame design. A Honey-Comb cereal box sits open beside him. The woman stands over him in her pale dress and black cardigan, palms turned up in a questioning gesture, looking at him expectantly. He keeps eating, then glances up with a caught-in-the-act expression.

The commercial opens in a cool, bluish nighttime setting with a close view of a silver-and-blue Nokia mobile phone held in one hand. Its small screen glows yellow-green, and a thumb presses the buttons below it. The Nokia name is visible above the screen. The phone is being used actively, with the user scrolling or selecting options on the keypad. The scene moves outside to a city street at night. A bar sits on a corner, with wet pavement reflecting streetlights. A blue neon sign reads “BAR,” and another neon sign glows in the window. A person walks near the entrance. Inside or near the bar, two young adults stand close together: a young man partly seen in profile and a young woman facing him. The woman has dark hair pulled back, expressive dark eyes, and wears a purple or burgundy fuzzy-collared jacket with a necklace. She smiles warmly, glancing up at the man and then down, as if responding to something on the phone or to his suggestion. The phone appears again in close-up. Its lit screen shows a progress bar and text that reads “Connecting to ...” with “opera” visible underneath, while a thumb hovers near the navigation keys. The visual idea shifts to entertainment: bright rows of stage or theatre lights shine against a dark background, then an ornate theatre ceiling appears, with circular warm lights and a central glowing fixture. Another close-up of the Nokia screen shows a typed message: “Please hold two tickets.” The words “Options” and “Clear” appear at the bottom of the screen, and the thumb presses the phone’s soft keys. The woman returns, smiling and looking pleased, lowering her gaze again as if the plan is taking shape. The phone is shown once more, now displaying a travel-related menu. The word “Travel” appears near the top, and “Flight Status” is visible as a selected item, with “Options” and “Back” at the bottom. This is followed by a night view of a polished silver propeller airplane on a runway or tarmac. Its propellers spin, and the aircraft’s metallic body reflects warm yellow lights. A quick series of night-life images follows: a tree-lined path with lights in the distance, a patio or outdoor café area filled with large cream-colored umbrellas, a close-up of pink neon letters, and performers in red costumes with flames. One performer holds or breathes fire, creating a large bright burst against the dark surroundings. The woman looks back at the man with a calm, knowing expression, her face lit in cool blue tones. Near the end, a hand holds the Nokia phone up against a blurred nighttime cityscape, with soft circles of blue and white light in the background. A small disclaimer appears along the bottom: “Service is not available in all locations. Please check with your service provider.” The final visuals turn bright white. From above, many tiny people move across a clean white space, first appearing as scattered crowds and then gathering into dense patterns. Their bodies form large grey shapes and letters, gradually spelling out the Nokia logo. The word “NOKIA” becomes clear, followed by the slogan “CONNECTING PEOPLE” beneath it. A faint outline of a phone appears above the logo, leaving the commercial on the Nokia brand mark against a white background.

A green freeway sign appears overhead reading “10 West Los Angeles,” placing the drive near Los Angeles. A glowing circular graphic with the word “vibe” flashes over dark, blurred imagery, like a logo made of concentric rings and crosshairs. The Vibe is then seen from above and alongside on a desert road, with low hills and scrubland in the background. White on-screen review text appears over the moving car: “Here comes the Pontiac Vibe,” credited to “San Jose Mercury News.” The silver vehicle continues along the open road, sunlight reflecting off its hood and windshield. The “vibe” circle graphic briefly overlays the car again, then the scene shifts to a distant city skyline under a pale sky, followed by another flashing circular “vibe” logo. Close-up views emphasize the car’s front headlamp, grille, front bumper, and spinning wheel as it drives through a narrow urban street between buildings. The visual style is high contrast, with strong glare and deep shadows. The car appears parked or moving slowly across a wide, barren plain with tall, dark rock formations in the background, resembling desert monuments. It faces slightly toward the viewer, showing its triangular Pontiac grille and rounded headlamps, with the empty landscape spreading behind it. Another “vibe” graphic appears over a roadside sign, then a sign for Wisconsin is shown, framed by wooden posts with words such as “Industry,” “Recreation,” and “Agriculture” around it; the center includes the word “drive” and a welcoming message. The Vibe returns in close-up, lit by a warm low sun, and more white review text appears: “Fun to drive, fun to look at,” credited to “LA Times.” The car’s wheel spins in close detail, then its side doors, roof rails, and rear quarter are shown as it speeds along a tilted highway view, shrinking into the distance while the quote remains on screen. A nighttime city scene follows, with wet-looking streets or strong reflections, bright headlights, streetlamps, and a skyline in the distance. The word “illinois” appears in white near the top of a dark city view, though the buildings are partly obscured by shadow and glare. Inside the car, a light-skinned hand reaches to the center console and grips the manual gearshift. The dashboard is dark with circular vents and controls. Outside again, the Vibe comes around a rural bend past a bare tree and low hills, its headlights bright against the road. A green overhead road sign reads “57 South Memphis,” with arrows pointing down. Another blue roadside sign appears briefly, including “Michelin” and “Central” among the visible words. The interior view centers on the steering wheel with the red Pontiac arrowhead badge in the middle, red-lit gauges behind it, and the driver’s hands on the wheel. The Vibe then navigates a downtown street bordered by tall rectangular office buildings, curving along a painted lane line. It is shown front-on, then from very close alongside its front wheel and side panels as it drives on a winding road near hills and brush. A brief high, tilted view looks down over rough green-brown terrain; at the right edge, part of a person or piece of equipment is visible close to the viewer, while a small light-colored vehicle appears far below on the ground. The image is brief and abstract, but it reinforces movement across varied places. A circular graphic transitions into the word “Pontiac” over the Vibe driving through a city street. The car moves between tall buildings, and white text appears across the lower part of the image: “Pontiac Vibe - Tight,” credited to “Motor Trend.” The vehicle continues forward in low, close views, passing other cars parked or driving nearby. Its side windows reflect the striped facades of surrounding buildings. The text stays on screen as the car’s front, wheels, side doors, and rear quarter panels pass by. A close-up of the rear badge shows “Vibe GT” in chrome lettering on the silver body. A green overhead sign then reads “New York Heckscher Pk 1 Mile,” with route shields above it. City traffic appears ahead in bright haze, with several cars silhouetted against the light, followed by a low rear view of the Vibe driving between tall buildings. Inside again, a driver wearing a short-sleeved plaid shirt holds the steering wheel with one hand while the other adjusts a knob on the center console below the audio and climate controls. The Vibe bursts through or drives amid a cloud of pale dust or mist, its front end briefly visible before the white cloud swallows much of the body. Neon letters fill the screen in close-up, then pull together into the famous roadside sign reading “Welcome to Fabulous Las Vegas Nevada,” with red circular letters along the top and “LAS VEGAS” in large black capitals. The glowing circular “vibe” logo appears once more. The silver Vibe drives along a bright city street lined with palm trees and a pale building wall, its side and roof rails catching the sunlight. It continues past trees and building shadows, then is seen from behind driving through a darker urban passage. In the final product-focused sequence, the car is shown in a dark, glossy setting with dramatic highlights sliding across its silver body. A circular graphic briefly frames the rear before the view moves along the side panels and front fender. White price text appears at the upper right: “Really cool at $16,900.” At the lower left, smaller text reads “As shown $19,900,” with fine-print disclaimer text beneath, and the red Pontiac arrowhead logo appears near the lower right. The final view presents the Vibe from the front three-quarter angle: silver hood, black center grille with the Pontiac split shape, bright headlamp, and a low fog light glowing below, while the price remains prominent on screen.

A pale blue, clinical-looking consultation room opens the commercial. The room has bright fluorescent ceiling panels, an examination table on the left, medical cabinets and equipment against the walls, framed certificates, and a desk in the middle. A middle-aged man in a dark suit sits facing an older, balding man behind the desk, who appears to be a medical professional. The mood is stark and serious. A glass of water, papers, folders, a telephone, and office items sit on the desk between them. The suited man is shown from the front, seated upright and tense. He has short dark hair, light skin, and a worried, slightly blank expression. Behind him are an X-ray image, a metal medical cabinet, and examination-room fixtures. The older man behind the desk, wearing a white shirt and dark tie, looks back at him with a grave expression, one hand near paperwork. The younger man’s face tightens as he listens. He looks stunned, his eyes widening and his mouth parting slightly, as though absorbing alarming news. His face fills more of the view, and he turns his head, still anxious and disoriented. The scene shifts to the same man now inside a car, seen in profile from the driver’s seat. He is wearing the same dark suit and grips the steering wheel. Through the windows, the structure of a bridge passes by, with pale light and steel beams outside. The interior is clean and upscale, with a dark dashboard, pale seats, and a rear-view mirror. As the road stretches ahead between bridge supports, his expression changes dramatically: he beams with excitement, mouth open in a delighted shout or laugh, eyes bright, leaning forward with both hands on the wheel. A sheet of paper with a Mercedes-Benz logo at the top is shown close up, resembling a vehicle information sheet or brochure. Most of the printed text is too small to read, but a simple image of a car appears near the bottom, reinforcing the Mercedes-Benz connection. The silver Mercedes sedan then appears head-on, driving down a broad city street lined with tall, pale buildings. Its front grille, hood ornament area, rounded headlights, and polished body are prominent. The street surface looks wet and reflective. Inside the car, the man looks relaxed and pleased, now smiling softly as he drives, a seatbelt across his chest. Outside, the silver sedan sweeps along the curbside through a deep puddle. Two pedestrians in business clothing walk on the sidewalk to the left, one carrying a coat or bag. As the car rushes past, water sprays up in a dramatic white splash along the curb, while the pedestrians remain on the sidewalk beside the city buildings. The setting changes to a waterfront road under a clear blue sky. A city skyline sits across the water in the distance. Bright red balloons are arranged in a long row along the roadside, floating at regular intervals. In the foreground, a small airport vehicle carries orange traffic cones, and a large cargo container on the left bears an Amazon label. A closer view shows a worker in a neon safety vest and hard hat handling a thick hose connected to an open panel beneath the aircraft, suggesting servicing or fueling activity. Inside a warehouse or sorting facility, many brown Amazon packages travel along metal roller conveyors. One conveyor runs straight through the scene while another curves in a semicircle. The boxes, with shipping labels and Amazon smile marks, move in an orderly stream through bright yellow industrial structures and railings. Next, masked Amazon delivery workers unload packages from the open side of a delivery vehicle. One worker in a blue Amazon vest, white face mask, and light gloves crouches at the doorway while holding a medium cardboard box with the Amazon smile on it. Large green delivery bags are stacked inside the vehicle behind him. Another uniformed worker stands nearby holding a handheld device or phone, watching the unloading. A close view of a dark vehicle door shows bold white and blue lettering: “100% Electric” above “Delivering Shipment Zero.” A person’s hand at the left holds a charging plug near the vehicle, visually connecting the text to electric delivery. A small number “15” sticker is visible near the lettering. An aerial view follows a blue Amazon semi-trailer truck with a white cab driving along a multi-lane highway bordered by green vegetation. The trailer carries a large white Amazon smile logo. The truck moves steadily along the road, with misty or hazy greenery around it. Back at an airport runway, a white “Prime Air” cargo plane lifts off. Its landing gear is still extended as it rises above the runway, the blue Prime Air lettering large along the fuselage and the Amazon smile visible on the tail. The plane climbs gradually, moving across a pale sky with airport buildings and treeline low in the background. A wide aerial view shows a large industrial parking lot and logistics facility. Rows of vehicles fill the lot: many dark vans lined up in neat rows, smaller cars parked in groups, and yellow vehicles near a white warehouse building. Streets border the site, with additional cars parked along the curb. The area looks like an operations hub or fleet yard. The commercial then moves inside a spacious vehicle design or workshop environment with polished floors, high windows, and bright linear ceiling lights. A full-size delivery van prototype sits in the center, initially covered in an orange clay-like or matte material. Several workers move around it, some standing on ladders, others kneeling near the wheels or working along the body. Design boards or presentation panels line the back wall. As the sequence progresses, the van’s appearance changes from orange to a dark blue finished surface with flowing light-colored lines along the roof and sides and an Amazon smile mark on the side. Workers continue inspecting, adjusting, and working around it, with tools, stools, boxes, and equipment scattered nearby. The final view of the workshop presents the completed dark blue electric-style delivery van standing prominently in the clean, bright space. A close view shows hands typing on a laptop keyboard. The person’s fingers move across the keys, with a softly blurred green outdoor background beyond the computer. This suggests data or planning work connected to the transportation scenes. Henry appears again in a close side view wearing his black face mask and glasses. Only part of his face is visible, with the mask covering his nose and mouth. His eyes look focused behind the lenses, and greenery remains softly blurred behind him. He is then shown once more in the leafy outdoor setting without the close mask view dominating, standing comfortably with trees behind him. He looks engaged and begins to smile slightly, his expression warm and thoughtful as he continues speaking. The commercial ends on a high aerial view of a road running through green land partly covered by soft white clouds or mist. A large white Amazon smile logo appears over the landscape, centered across the road and greenery, becoming the final visual emblem.

At night on a rain-wet city street, a dark blue BMW SUV sits near the curb outside low brick and stucco buildings. The pavement reflects streetlights, traffic signals, and teal and red glows from nearby signs. Small white on-screen text near the bottom reads, “European model shown.” Two adults, mostly silhouetted, approach the vehicle: one stands near the driver’s side by the front of the car, while another, with long hair and a coat, walks toward the passenger side. The BMW’s glossy body and bright front lights stand out against the damp, dim industrial-looking block with barred windows and a red vertical wall light. The SUV pulls away from the curb and moves down the empty street. From above, it passes a corner building with a lit entrance and colorful rounded decorations or fixtures, while its headlights cast pale blue-white light across the wet road. The vehicle is then seen from behind on a darker street lined with brick buildings; its distinctive red rear lights form angular, glowing shapes, reflected faintly in the slick pavement. Small white disclaimer text appears along the bottom, stating that all lights shown may not be available on all models. The BMW continues through a tunnel or underpass with high pale walls and lane markings. Its headlights shine directly forward, and the front grille with BMW’s twin kidney shape becomes prominent as the SUV advances. The front end fills the view: bright, crisp headlamp shapes, the chrome grille bars, and the deep blue paint catching the tunnel lighting. A following view highlights the rear of the vehicle, including the BMW badge, a license plate reading “TRM205,” and the sculpted red tail lights. The SUV emerges onto a quieter, tree-lined residential street at night. It turns or pauses under warm streetlamps, its body outlined by reflections on the damp road and by the glow of its lights. It then reaches a modern home set behind low walls, hedges, and tall trees. From above, the BMW sits in the driveway near landscaped greenery lit by small garden lights, its headlights illuminating the path ahead. Inside the house, a young child with shoulder-length brown hair and a blue top appears at a large window. Warm indoor light from a floor lamp behind the child contrasts with the dark exterior brick wall and night garden outside. The child looks out through the glass, smiling and pressing a hand near their mouth in an excited, pleased gesture; their reflection is visible in the window beside them. Outside, the dark blue BMW X3 rests in the driveway with its headlights still on, the chrome grille and large wheels visible against the softly lit shrubs and trees. An adult is faintly visible inside the vehicle, while the home and car are visually connected by the warm house lights and the vehicle’s cool headlight beams.
