excerpt: On an elevated city train platform, commuters stand along the left edge waiting as a silver train approaches on tracks to the right. The platform is bordered by tall glass-and-steel office buildings, and the scene is washed with bright daylight. Several adults in business or city clothes stand close to the platform edge: a woman looks down at something in her hands, a man in a light suit stands upright, and others wait behind them. As the train draws nearer, glowing bands of color—green, blue, purple, and pink—stream along the rails and wrap around the train’s sides, as if energy is flowing through the transit system. The train’s headlights are on, and its rounded front fills more of the scene as it arrives. The view opens out over a dense urban landscape. Rows of buildings, roads, rail lines, and elevated tracks stretch toward a skyline of tall towers. Across the city, the same luminous colored trails run along streets and transit routes, crossing bridges and weaving between blocks. The light ribbons make the city look like a connected network, with bright blue, green, pink, and white paths moving through the grid. At street level, traffic moves through a canyon of tall downtown buildings. Cars and a large white bus travel along a multi-lane road, while pedestrians line the sidewalks on both sides. Faint colored glows trace around some vehicles and along the roadway, continuing the visual idea of energy moving through everyday transportation. Beside a large purple-and-green bus, a young adult woman with straight black hair and bangs stands near the curb. She wears a dark jacket and carries a black shoulder bag. She looks down at a smartphone held in one hand, its screen or surrounding glow reflecting pinkish light. On the bus, yellow route text reads “K750,” and higher up along the side is a visible banner reading “Powered by Natural Gas,” with a green leaf-like symbol. The woman lowers the phone slightly and turns toward the bus door as if preparing to board. The scene changes to a broad, high view over a gridded city at dusk or night. Streets form long straight lines stretching to the horizon, lit by white and multicolored bands that run through the urban pattern. The glowing paths create a sense of power spreading across neighborhoods and transportation corridors. Inside a softly lit room, a young girl with long light-brown or blonde hair, wearing a red sleeveless top, sits or stands beside a white electronic toy or keyboard. She smiles as she presses its brightly colored square keys, arranged in rows of blues, purples, greens, yellows, and reds. A bright window is to her right, and faint rainbow light overlays drift across the scene, linking her domestic setting to the same flowing energy imagery seen in the city. The view returns to a wide aerial of a city with a lake or open water at the far left and a skyline of skyscrapers in the distance. In the foreground are neighborhoods, parks, and sports fields, including baseball diamonds. Curved green arcs ripple over a park area, while blue and green light bands trace roads and routes through the city. The luminous paths gradually converge toward the center, forming a large V-like shape over the urban grid. More colors—red, orange, pink, blue, and green—intensify and cross over one another. The city image darkens into an abstract graphic of bright, intersecting beams. Thick orange, pink, purple, and white strokes cross diagonally, forming a glowing X shape on a dark background. To the right, a round, glowing ring resembling the letter O appears. The final image is a close abstract view of these illuminated letter-like forms, visually echoing the ExxonMobil branding as the colored energy trails resolve into a bold, radiant graphic.

A wide, icy mountain range fills the screen under a pale blue sky, with jagged white peaks stretching into the distance. On one snowy slope, an adult skier in winter gear appears: a turquoise jacket with dark sleeves, beige pants, black gloves, ski poles, a dark helmet or hood, and reflective goggles. The skier moves downhill across open snow, small against the vast alpine landscape, then launches off a crest. High above the mountains, the skier twists into an aerial flip, skis and poles sweeping upward as the body rotates against the sky. A close view briefly shows the skier’s face partly hidden by a black helmet and large blue-purple mirrored goggles, the mouth set in concentration as snow and sky blur behind. The setting changes to an indoor ice track. The ice is glossy and pale, bordered by dark walls and rows of bright overhead lights that curve away into the distance. A speed skater’s blade carves along the ice at close range, then several adult skaters in tight racing suits appear. They wear black suits with red shoulders or panels, white-and-black caps, and dark wraparound goggles. They lean forward in deep, aerodynamic positions, one arm often tucked behind the back while the other swings low near the ice. The group moves in a staggered line around the bend, knees bent sharply, skates crossing over as they push through the turn. Close views isolate faces under caps and goggles, showing focused, compressed expressions and taut posture. The skaters pass close together, their red-and-black uniforms streaking across the shiny surface. One athlete drops extremely low, almost horizontal, with a hand skimming the ice, while another continues upright ahead; the prone figure slides along the ice before the image shifts away. An adult athlete then stands facing forward in a narrow, dim passage or tunnel, both hands raised to adjust a glossy black helmet. The outfit has red sleeves with white stripes and a gray torso panel, suggesting winter racing gear. The background is patterned with gray, graffiti-like or mural-like shapes, giving the space a hard, urban feel. The athlete’s face is mostly shadowed by the helmet. Outside, a bright, snow-covered city appears. Tall modern buildings with glass, white façades, and geometric patterns rise around an empty street or plaza. A black convertible-style car is parked beside a curb, its long dark body contrasting with the pale snow. The helmeted athlete in the red-sleeved suit walks past the car. From inside or near the car, the athlete is seen moving toward a low black sled resting on the snow. The sled is narrow and flat with raised handles or supports, like a skeleton sled. The athlete steps beside it and lowers onto it headfirst, chest down, arms bent at the front, legs stretched straight behind with red lower legs visible. The skeleton sled now travels along an icy track that winds through an urban structure. The track has high white walls, blue guardrails, and overhead concrete beams, with city buildings visible beyond. The sled rushes through sweeping curves, hugging the wall. At times the athlete is a small dark shape banking along the far side of the track; then the front of the sled fills the image, rounded and glossy black, with the athlete’s red-striped legs tucked along either side. The sled’s nose points straight ahead as it skims close to the ice, the white walls reflecting across its curved surface. The action returns briefly to speed skating. A skater in the red-and-black suit leans forward, face partly hidden by dark goggles and a white-black cap, driving one arm back and the other forward in a powerful stride. The posture remains low and urgent, with the ice and dark rink background streaking behind. The skier reappears high in a cold blue sky, still in the turquoise jacket and beige pants, rotating through another aerial move with skis extended upward. The figure moves out of view, leaving mostly sky, then a close-up returns to the skier’s helmeted head and mirrored goggles. The face is partly visible at the edge of the screen, focused and calm against the pale blue background. White branding appears over the mountain sky: the bold word “VISA” on the left, separated by a thin vertical line from the Olympic rings on the right. Beneath it, smaller white text reads “worldwide sponsor.” The background settles on a wide view of snowy mountain peaks. Blue and gold rectangular bands slide in behind the logo, echoing Visa’s brand colours, and the small text changes to “everywhere you want to be.” The final image holds the Visa wordmark, the Olympic rings, and the slogan over the panoramic white mountain range.

Two hooded figures stand close together in a dim, worn-looking interior, facing a bright window. One wears a deep red hooded sweatshirt, the other a pale gray or white hood under a black jacket. The room has patterned wallpaper and an old, urban-apartment feel. Bright daylight pours in from outside, briefly flaring across the scene. The figure in the red sweatshirt turns out to be an oversized, humanlike hamster. With pale paws, it pulls the red hood down and reveals a large tan hamster head with rounded ears, glossy dark eyes, whiskers, and a small pink nose. The sweatshirt has bold white script across the chest reading “Hamstar,” and the hamster wears thick gold chains. Behind it, another hamster wears a white hoodie under a black leather jacket, with the hood and a black cap partly shading its face. Outside, a group of similarly human-sized hamsters gathers on a city sidewalk in front of an older brick apartment building. They are dressed in urban streetwear: the red “Hamstar” hoodie, the white hoodie with black leather jacket and yellow shoes, a green tracksuit with white stripes and large round headphones around the neck, and other oversized hoodies and jackets. A large old-style boombox sits on a stone post near the entrance. The hamsters stand on the stoop and curb, gesturing and moving as if dancing or greeting each other. The city setting is dense and slightly gritty, with brick façades, metal railings, and narrow sidewalks. A city skyline appears, with tall buildings in the distance and a sign on a nearby structure reading “H&H.” The urban theme continues with a street sign high between tall buildings: one sign reads “HAMSTERDAM AV,” and below it a “ONE WAY” sign points to the right. Back at street level, one hamster in the green tracksuit embraces the hamster in the white hoodie and black leather jacket beside a brick wall. The green-suited hamster’s round headphones hang prominently at the chest. Soon the lime-green Kia Soul appears parked at the curb in front of the apartment buildings. Its boxy shape, rounded front, Kia badge, and shiny wheels are visible. Several hamsters dance and pose around it, with the red-hoodie hamster near the front passenger side and the white-hoodie hamster moving by the driver’s side. Small legal text appears along the bottom of the image while the vehicle is displayed. The commercial starts visually comparing the Kia with absurd hamster-sized alternatives. A giant silver toaster, about the size of a small vehicle, rolls down the street with two hamsters sitting on top of it. Its black lever and slots are visible, making it unmistakably a toaster. In the foreground, the white-hoodie hamster in the black leather jacket gestures toward it, then points emphatically, as if dismissing that option. The same hamster then stands beside the Kia’s front grille and badge, dancing with both paws raised, drawing attention back to the real car. The toaster continues down the street past brownstone-style buildings and a red fire hydrant, while other hamsters stand on sidewalks watching. The toaster glides like a vehicle, with its polished metal sides reflecting light. In another city lot, the red “Hamstar” hamster stands beside the boombox, while the green Kia Soul sits behind. The white-hoodie hamster dances on a piece of flattened cardboard on the ground, using it like a dance mat. A drummer hamster appears outside a theater entrance, wearing an olive-green parka, a dark knit cap, and a chain necklace. It sits at a drum kit and raises drumsticks over a snare and cymbal. Behind it, a theater marquee with rows of lights includes readable text such as “Moochie Mania.com presents” and “Moochie & the Woodchucks,” with a “Sat 8pm” listing beneath. Other hamsters move in the background near the theater. The Kia Soul is then shown driving through a city street from behind and alongside, its lime-green paint standing out against beige and gray buildings. The rear Kia badge, vertical taillights, roof rails, and square hatchback shape are clear. Inside the car, three hamsters ride in the front and back seats. The red “Hamstar” hamster drives with both paws on the steering wheel, looking forward. The white-hoodie hamster sits in the front passenger seat wearing a seatbelt, and the green tracksuit hamster sits in the back. Through the rear window, the giant toaster can be seen following along the road in the distance. As the Kia drives past, another oversized hamster alternative appears: a huge metal exercise wheel on a stand, like the kind used in small animal cages. A hamster runs inside the wheel on the sidewalk while the Kia passes smoothly beside it. Other hamsters stand along the street watching. The contrast is visual and comic: the real compact crossover cruises down the road while the hamster wheel and toaster look awkward and impractical. At a car wash, the white-hoodie hamster leans casually against the front corner of the green Kia, one paw resting near the headlight. A sign above the building reads “CAR WASH” with a star graphic. The hamster gestures outward, and the view shifts across the car wash area to another makeshift transportation option: several hamsters are inside a large cardboard box shaped like a car. The box has cut-out windows, drawn-on circular headlights, a red arrow, and pink flame graphics along the side. Their furry legs stick out underneath as they shuffle the cardboard “car” forward by foot. Two hamsters in red clothing stand near the car wash building watching. Inside the Kia, the dashboard and center console are shown. The audio controls and climate dials fill the center, and a small red display glows on the stereo. A hamster paw holds a smartphone or music player near the passenger side; the screen shows album art and text, though the details are small. Fine print appears along the bottom while this device and the car’s interior controls are shown. The cardboard box car later travels down a city street behind or near other odd appliances, including a large washing machine-like vehicle. The cardboard car wobbles badly, tips onto one side, and collapses into a crumpled heap on the pavement. Hamsters inside are partially visible through the cut-out openings as the box folds down. A subway entrance sign nearby reads “45 Stree Station” with additional text including “Downtown to South Ferry.” Other hamsters on the sidewalk look on. Back at the car wash, two hamsters in pale pink skirts dance facing each other in front of the red-and-white building. Elsewhere in a wide city lot, the green Kia Soul sits on the left while the white-hoodie hamster dances beside it. On the right, the giant toaster stands with hamsters perched on top and a black electrical cord trailing along the ground, making it look even less like a practical vehicle. The Kia continues driving through sunlit city streets. The front grille, rounded headlights, lower black bumper, and spinning wheels are emphasized as it moves forward. In the background, the toaster-like contraptions and other hamster figures blur past on the road and sidewalks, while the Kia remains the polished, functional vehicle. From the side window, the white-hoodie hamster in the front passenger seat bobs and moves both paws as if dancing, still buckled in. The red “Hamstar” hamster drives beside them, focused ahead, with the green exterior door frame visible at the edge. The commercial ends on a clean white information screen. On the left is the Kia oval logo above the words “KIA MOTORS” and the slogan “The Power to Surprise.” On the right, large text reads “2010 KIA SOUL.” Beneath it, pricing information reads “$149 / Month,” “36 Month Lease,” “$2,299 Due at Signing,” and “SOUL + A/T.” Near the lower left is a small award graphic with the quoted text “TOP SAFETY PICK,” followed by dense fine print across the bottom.

The commercial opens inside a high-rise room, looking past a windowsill toward downtown buildings and a street far below. On the sill sit small toys: two little metal robot figures at the left and a row of toy vehicles in red, yellow, and green. The city outside is muted and realistic, with stone and brick buildings, while the toys in the foreground give the scene a childhood feel. As the view shifts outward toward the street canyon, the toys slip out of attention and a large, flat, childlike cutout figure appears outside among the buildings, as if a drawing has come to life at giant scale. At street level, normal city traffic and pedestrians continue through an intersection. A cyclist rides across the road, cars and a bus wait or pass in the background, and red traffic lights hang overhead. Into this ordinary scene drift pastel, paper-like fish shapes, outlined in crayon colors and casting faint shadows on the pavement. A colorful hand-drawn train, made of boxy cars with crayon wheels and a cloud of cartoon smoke above it, rolls across the intersection from the right. Its cars are decorated in bright pink, yellow, red, and blue. Two adult men on the sidewalk pause and watch; one bald man in dark clothes holds a bag at his side, while another man with a shoulder bag stands nearby. The animated train continues away down the street as more floating fish glide past the real buildings and traffic. The fantasy expands around a parked white delivery truck with a red stripe. A man stands at the truck’s open back door, and pedestrians walk on a stepped plaza nearby. From around the truck rise more child-drawn cutouts: puffy white clouds, triangular rockets with colored windows, a blue robot, and a yellow sun. They lift upward between tall office towers, filling the sky above the city. The drawings have thick outlines and visible crayon or marker texture, as if made by a young child, but they move through the real urban space like enormous balloons or paper kites. From above, rooftops and streets appear below while a huge smiling stick-figure person, drawn in red lines on white paper, stretches up between the buildings. Its round head and long arms are much taller than the surrounding rooftops. Nearby, a small blue-outlined cloud floats, and a yellow crayon rocket glides across the buildings. The smiling figure reaches toward the cloud, then leans between the towers, still grinning, surrounded by other drifting paper clouds. Another city block shows a tall, rectangular, paper-bag-like character standing above a low wall. It has scribbled brown hair and a sad face, drawn with simple dark lines. To the right hovers a child-drawn flying saucer with a white dome and yellow-green lights. Bright yellow zigzag shapes suddenly flare around the sad character like comic-book energy or lightning. The character’s expression changes into a smile, and spring-like curls pop up over its head, turning the gloomy figure into a delighted one while the saucer remains in the sky. A large purple monster-like drawing appears at the end of a street between rows of buildings. It has a simple triangular body, a square window-like patch on its belly, skinny legs, and three long eye stalks with huge round eyes. Pedestrians cross in front of it at a crosswalk, and cars line both sides of the street. The creature’s eyes and arms shift positions as it bobs along, then it drifts toward the right edge of the street while a real city bus passes behind the pedestrians. A small crayon cloud floats overhead, reinforcing the mix of everyday downtown life and imaginary drawings. More paper clouds move between tall glass-and-concrete towers, and a large blue robot drawing peeks from between the buildings. The robot has a square face, blocky body, and simple blue outlines, with a pale blue scribbled torso. White cloud cutouts float in the foreground and background, sliding through the vertical corridors formed by the skyscrapers. The scene settles on a rooftop or elevated outdoor terrace in the middle of the city. A white adult man, around middle age, sits alone on a black metal bench. He has shoulder-length light brown hair, a full beard, and wears a dark business suit with a light blue shirt and a loosened patterned tie. A dark bag rests on the bench beside him, and a takeaway coffee cup sits on the ground in front. Behind the low concrete wall, downtown buildings fill the background. One of the paper clouds floats past behind him. He looks down toward his lap, calm and slightly tired at first, holding a small dark object near his hand. As he remains seated, his expression softens. In closer views, his head is bowed, then he raises his eyes a little and begins to smile gently. Behind the wall, the purple three-eyed creature peeks up, its large round eyes appearing over the edge like a playful surprise, then its eye stalks bob and turn into rounded purple shapes as it passes behind him. The final imagery changes from the real city into a clean, bright, abstract digital space. Glossy, translucent blue bubbles float on a white background, surrounded by streams of small blue and white spheres arranged in sweeping spirals, like a flowing network. Inside the bubbles are glimpses of communication and media: a wall of many video screens, a handheld device showing a screen, hands using a touchscreen device, a digital interface with pictures and icons, and a tablet or e-reader displaying a news-style page with a bold black title area at the top. Smaller bubbles show additional images, including a tiny airplane silhouette and other screens. The bubbles drift together in layered clusters, visually linking phones, tablets, video, news, and digital content in one connected, imaginative network.

The commercial begins with a bright blue product display that appears unrelated to the Jeep scenes: a bottle of blue Listerine Cool Mint mouthwash stands in the center, surrounded by small cartoon-like mouth characters. Large white words behind it read, “BRING OUT THE BOLD.” The Jeep story then begins in a dim, warmly lit office high above a city at sunset. A younger man with dark curly hair, wearing dark clothing, stands beside a desk holding papers or a folder. Across from him, a bald, middle-aged man in a white dress shirt and dark tie sits in a black office chair behind the desk, with a laptop and office items in front of him. The seated man gestures with one hand, then both hands, as if giving instructions or rejecting something, while the standing man listens. The office has large windows, shelving, and a polished executive atmosphere. The younger man then appears in profile near the window, looking outward toward a city skyline glowing in the evening light, suggesting he is leaving the office environment behind. A silver Jeep Compass appears driving through a city street at night, its headlights bright against storefronts and apartment buildings. White centered text reads, “INTRODUCING THE ALL-NEW COMPASS.” The same text remains as the setting shifts to open countryside: the silver SUV drives along a curving two-lane road through dry, brown hills. Its seven-slot Jeep grille, daytime running lights, and compact SUV shape are clearly visible as it rounds the bend and approaches. Inside the vehicle, the younger dark-haired man is now driving. He sits upright, focused on the road, with warm light falling across his face. A close view of the center dashboard shows a hand using the glossy touchscreen. White text over the screen reads, “AWARD-WINNING UCONNECT SYSTEM,” while the display itself shows vehicle interface graphics. The Jeep continues along a wide road through a rugged desert-like landscape with mountains in the background, the sky tinted with late-day colors. Small fine print appears low on the screen while the silver Compass is shown in profile, moving steadily forward with its lights on. The interior is then highlighted: a close view of a pale leather seat shows smooth upholstery, stitching, and an embossed “Jeep” logo on the seatback. White text across the center reads, “REFINED LEATHER-TRIMMED INTERIOR.” The scene returns to the SUV on a winding road at sunset, with the sun low and bright ahead, casting golden glare across the road and outlining the front of the vehicle. Another interior view shows the touchscreen navigation display in the center console. A hand touches the map interface, and white text reads, “MOST TECHNOLOGY IN ITS CLASS.” The final driving images show the silver Jeep Compass coming toward the viewer on an open rural highway under a pink and purple evening sky. Its headlights and lower amber lights are on, with low hills, utility poles, and open land around it. Large white text appears over the front of the vehicle: “YOUR ALL-NEW COMPASS.”

A brief bright-blue pet-supply image appears first: the white word “chewy” floats above a blue box of pet products, with a small dog sitting on the left, a plush toy and treats in the center, and a white dog sniffing on the right. The scene then shifts sharply into the Mazda commercial’s main visual theme. A young, lean, shirtless Asian man identified by on-screen text as “BRUCE LEE” stands in a Japanese-style room with sliding grid doors and warm lantern light. He faces forward with an intense, focused expression, his shoulders squared and his body poised for action. He begins moving a pair of nunchaku, first close to his body and then with quick, controlled arm motions. In the same room, he launches into a high, acrobatic flying kick, knees tucked and one foot extended, suspended in midair against the simple interior of wall panels, mats, and low furniture. The commercial then turns to archival-looking footage of an elderly white-haired man in a dark suit at a drafting table, identified by on-screen text as “FRANK LLOYD WRIGHT.” He bends over large architectural drawings, holding a pen or pencil in one hand and steadying the paper with the other. Close views show a hand working over a detailed building sketch. The drawing transitions to a finished architectural rendering of a large, rounded museum-like building with sweeping circular forms, then to old construction footage of the same structure being built in a city block, surrounded by scaffolding, cranes, and tall buildings. It then becomes the completed white spiral exterior of the Guggenheim Museum, its smooth curved bands wrapping around the building beside city streets and trees. Next, black-and-white baseball footage shows an African American player in a Brooklyn Dodgers uniform and cap, identified by on-screen text as “JACKIE ROBINSON.” He stands near the dugout, looking upward and outward with a serious, composed expression, while another uniformed player stands partly visible beside him. The scene cuts to a crowd of men in stadium seats, some leaning forward and gesturing with raised arms. Robinson then bats: he plants his feet, swings through the pitch, and starts running. A wide view of the ballfield shows players spread across the diamond and outfield, with a packed grandstand behind them. More crowd footage shows spectators cheering and clapping. Robinson sprints along the baseline in a Dodgers uniform, his body leaning forward with effort. Close views of his cleats show them pounding into the dirt, kicking up dust as he runs. The dust from the baseball field visually gives way to a glossy red Mazda3 moving through a city street. The car first flashes past in side view, then is seen from behind as it drives away along a shaded urban road lined with buildings and trees. It appears again from the front three-quarter angle, bright red paint reflecting sunlight, with Mazda’s winged grille emblem centered in a black grille, narrow swept-back headlights, round lower lamps, and silver wheels. Small fine-print text appears near the bottom. The red Mazda then drives on a curving forest road with double yellow center lines, surrounded by dense green trees. The car comes toward the viewer around the bend, headlights on, then glides past close enough to show the sculpted hood, side mirrors, and flowing side windows. The man in goggles returns in extreme close-up, his round lenses reflecting bright light, his expression intense and exaggerated. The simulator flashes again in electric colors. The fighting-game clips keep coming: the blond fighter in the blue jacket stands in the desert arena while an opponent is hurled away, and another bright, inverted-looking Tekken screen shows directional arrows and button prompts over a fighter, suggesting controller inputs. The man in goggles appears once more, very close to the viewer, his face washed in white and yellow light. A red-tinted racing game screen appears briefly, almost entirely covered by a red overlay, then the Wipeout-style racing footage returns on a tan, wooden or stone-looking track crossing a mountainous landscape. The craft speeds forward, with red text at the top and a timer at the bottom. Tekken appears again in an icy arena, where a shirtless fighter in black pants strikes a silver or armored-looking opponent; large controller icons sit at the lower left. Warhawk returns with a gray aircraft flying beside a futuristic structure in space or a dark sky, followed by a bright blocky explosion. NFL GameDay returns for a moment, with a mass of football players colliding around the line of scrimmage. The goggled man appears again, now tinted orange and yellow, teeth bared in an intense grin or shout. Near the end, graphic text elements build the commercial’s warning visually. A large black oval shape with a glowing blue “U” appears over a pale, blueprint-like background. Then an enormous dark letter “R” fills the screen. Next, the word “NOT” appears in bold black letters over the same icy blue technical background. Red glowing lowercase “e”-like letters and shapes pulse over a busy orange, circuit-board-like collage, suggesting the continuation of the phrase heard in the audio context, “You are not ready.” The product imagery closes the commercial. A white Sony PlayStation console and controller appear against an electric green, smoky background. The controller’s colored button symbols are visible: green triangle, red circle, blue cross, and pink square. A dark, dramatic close-up shows the PlayStation console’s circular disc lid glowing blue-white, with a red beam of light near it. Then the white PlayStation controller is shown clearly on a black textured surface. The brand text “SONY” is printed across the top center, with the PlayStation logo and the word “PlayStation” below it. The “SELECT” and “START” buttons are labeled, and the square button is visible at the right edge of the close-up. After a blurred, fast-moving glimpse of people or figures in a warm-toned space, the commercial ends on an abstract orange-and-black mechanical background with the large white word “END” centered on screen.

A stark white surface with horizontal seams fills the screen. A thin dark line appears across it, then a shiny compact disc rises into view. The disc is shown large and centered, its reflective surface shimmering in bright pink, orange, red, and pale green around a clear center hole. The scene shifts to a futuristic white room with a gridded floor, white paneled walls, and two sculptural red lounge chairs placed symmetrically on either side. A young man in a white top is seen from behind at the center of the room. His brown hair whips forward dramatically, as if something powerful is rushing toward him or through him. When he is no longer in the center, a black rectangular game system or monitor-like object is visible ahead, suspended or displayed inside a vertical column of pale blue light between the two red chairs. The image changes to video game footage from a science-fiction cockpit view. A gray, cratered or metallic landscape stretches toward an orange sky. Instrument panels and small screens line the bottom edge. Bright purple laser beams fire toward blocky structures, which erupt into large orange and yellow explosions that fill more and more of the screen. Back in the white room, the young man is now reclined in a red chair, seen from above. He wears white clothing, his hair stands wildly upward, and he smiles with wide-eyed excitement. Orange flame-like blasts stream out horizontally from both sides of his head near his ears, exaggerating the idea that the game experience is overwhelming. Another white surface appears with a horizontal slit, and a second compact disc rises into view. This one glows mostly blue and green, with a pale highlight at the top. A different young player appears in a padded-looking white room. This person is youthful, dressed entirely in white, including a soft white cap, and sits in a bright green chair. They hold a black wired game controller with both hands, leaning forward and grinning while playing. A sequence of game images follows. First, a motorcycle racing game shows riders speeding down a city street between blocky buildings. A yellow vehicle is ahead, and a game display along the bottom includes labels such as “Player 1,” numbers, colored status bars, and the name “Pearl.” Then a soccer game appears in a stadium, with players in colored uniforms running across a green field under a blue sky. Next, a golf game shows a golfer standing by water and grass, with on-screen text including “Delacruz,” “1st stroke,” “506 yards,” “4 mph,” “Hole 18,” and “Par 5.” Another science-fiction game view shows a craft or platform moving through a gray industrial corridor with glowing orange-red elements. The white padded room returns from a high angle. The player in white stands near the green chair, still holding the wired controller. A black console sits on the floor to the left, with the controller cord trailing across the white floor. In front of the player, a section of the white wall is visibly cracked in a jagged pattern, as if damaged by the intensity of the play. A third compact disc appears, this time with purple, pink, and blue reflections around its center. Another young man, also dressed in white, plays with a black wired controller in a clean white space. He has brown hair parted at the center and looks intensely focused, holding the controller close to the viewer. Behind him are white shelves or alcoves containing pale disc-like shapes. More game footage follows. A fighting game shows two martial-arts characters battling on a red and gold platform in front of large red columns, snowy mountains, and an East Asian-style building. Health bars stretch across the top of the screen, with a timer reading “96.” One fighter kicks toward the other. A large animated martial artist then appears against a black background: first as a white silhouette, then in full color. He is muscular, with short brown hair, a torn white gi, red wrist wraps, and a guarded fighting pose. A monster truck game appears next. A large truck with oversized tires drives across a rough dirt track under a blue sky, then tips up and flips dramatically. An American football game follows from an overhead view: small players in red and white uniforms cluster and scatter on a green field near yellow goalposts, with the crowd visible beyond the end zone. Then a driving game is shown from inside a car, looking over a dashboard and steering wheel onto a curving road bordered by guardrails and rocky hills. The brown-haired young man in white reappears holding the controller. His face is comically distorted, with enlarged eyes and an exaggerated mouth, as if the game’s graphics or intensity have warped him. Then the viewpoint is low, looking up past his hands and controller. His head seems to detach and float or fall away from his body, moving upward and then off into the room. Finally, the lower half of the same player’s body is seen sitting in a bright yellow chair, still holding the controller. The black cord lies in a loose curve across the white floor. His head rolls or slides into the foreground on the carpet, separated from the body, but still animated and smiling. In the background, his headless body remains seated in the yellow chair with the controller, while his face in the foreground looks out with a dazed, pleased expression.

A balding, middle-aged man in a light blue dress shirt and patterned tie hurries up to an outdoor ATM set into a brick wall. Above the machine are the Mastercard overlapping red-and-yellow circles and a blue “CIRRUS” sign. He turns toward a younger man with thick curly hair, wearing a dark leather jacket over a green shirt. The younger man stands beside the ATM holding a small stack of dollar bills, while the balding man holds up a small greenish card as if asking for help. Pedestrians pass between them. The curly-haired man looks down at the card, then out to the side with a doubtful, uncertain expression, still clutching his cash. Both men end up looking off in the same direction, as if trying to figure out where to go. On another sidewalk, near an ATM mounted in a wall, two adults lean toward an elderly woman seated low beside a parked car. One person in a red patterned top points firmly into the distance, while another person in a beige vest leans in close and points as well. The elderly woman looks up at them as they appear to give complicated directions. The balding man is then seated in a car with the top down, holding up the same greenish card near his face. He smiles hopefully toward someone outside the car. A young woman with short dark hair, a bright pink hair scrunchie, hoop earrings, and a blue jacket faces him while holding a large brown paper grocery bag with a baguette sticking out. A passerby briefly blocks the view. The woman smiles at first, then looks more concerned and uncertain, hugging the bag to her chest and gesturing with one hand as if she does not know the answer. The man studies the card, flips it slightly in his fingers, and looks back up, still waiting for help. He next sits on the hood of a red car beside a cyclist in a white helmet, purple cycling shirt, black gloves, and cycling gear. Behind them is a roadside diner with large roof letters spelling part of “DINER.” The balding man holds folded papers or maps in his lap, while the cyclist grips the handlebars and points off to the side, apparently adding another set of directions. The man looks away in the direction indicated. A wide outdoor view shows a pale green metal truss bridge spanning calm water, with trees behind it. A small red car drives across the bridge, emphasizing that the search has taken him well away from the city streets. Back on a sunny sidewalk, the balding man bends forward beside a small elderly woman wearing a straw hat, large eyeglasses, a patterned blouse, and a vest. She gestures emphatically with one finger raised, then points outward and downward, giving a long, detailed explanation. The man listens with a serious, slightly weary expression, leaning in close at her height. She adjusts her glasses, waves her hand, and continues pointing, while pedestrians move in soft focus behind them along a tree-lined street. The focus shifts to the product in use. A hand holds a gray Mastercard card close to an ATM card slot. The card clearly shows the blue “MasterCard” name and the red-and-yellow Mastercard circles. The hand slides the card into the horizontal slot. The card goes partway in, with the logo still visible, then disappears deeper into the machine. Another ATM is shown with the Mastercard and CIRRUS logos below its screen and keypad. A hand retrieves a stack of cash from the cash dispenser, then moves to press buttons on the keypad. At the ATM, the balding man now stands beside a young woman with shoulder-length brown hair wearing a peach-colored blouse. They are outside a light-colored building with a small domed tower visible against a bright blue sky. The man holds up the greenish card near his chest while the woman holds cash. They look at each other, then she looks upward and points confidently into the distance, as if indicating a much simpler solution or location. The man watches her, appearing relieved but still slightly bemused. The image blends back to the elderly woman and the balding man on the sidewalk. White text appears along the lower part of the screen reading “MASTER THE MOMENT,” and the Mastercard overlapping red-and-yellow circles logo appears at the lower right with the “MasterCard” name. The elderly woman continues talking and gesturing with one raised finger, while the man leans beside her and eventually dips his head downward, as if exhausted by all the complicated directions.

The commercial opens inside the video game, on a dusty tan racecourse in a desert canyon. Several futuristic hover-motorcycles line up across the track, each with a rider in a helmet and racing suit. Low stone barriers run along both sides, orange canyon walls rise in the background, and a large overhead electronic sign hangs above the track. At first the sign reads “SET” in bright yellow block letters, then changes to “GO!” A white race timer appears in the upper left. The viewpoint sits just behind a green-and-teal hover bike marked with a large number 2, centered in the lane. When the race begins, the other racers surge forward, kicking up pale dust clouds and leaving the number 2 bike behind. Its rear glows red-orange as if powered, but it lags under the “GO!” sign while the pack pulls farther ahead. The scene jumps through different game courses to show the racing variety. On a narrow wooden plank bridge suspended over a deep rocky ravine, several hover bikes crowd together, including a large blue-and-white bike marked number 7 very close in front. The planks stretch in a thin line across the gap, with green terrain beyond the canyon. Then the setting changes to a dramatic, futuristic track at night or twilight. A rider speeds along a steeply banked wall, with a deep blue and purple sky, dark building-like structures, and a white lattice track or framework curving below. The bike appears to cling to the side of a twisting tube-like course before the image returns to the original desert starting stretch, where the number 2 bike is still under the glowing “GO!” sign. More racing clips follow. In a sandy canyon turn, hover bikes slide around a bend and throw up thick splashes of dust or sand; a small rating icon sits in the lower left. A close view shows a rider on a yellow-and-red bike marked number 3, wearing a white helmet with red accents. Another bike sweeps past on the inside of the curve, and a large sandy plume fills the left side of the track as racers disappear around the bend. The action then moves to a bright blue water course near a huge wall of falling water or spray. A red-and-yellow bike marked number 1 flies above the water, then lands and skims forward between orange buoys and industrial-looking structures. Next, the racers are on a snowy mountain track bordered by cliffs and rocks. Several hover bikes carve through the snow, leaving pale tracks and blue-tinted glow beneath them as they bunch together and race under a sign ahead. The commercial returns again to the desert starting area with the number 2 bike still sitting beneath the big yellow “GO!” sign. Suddenly the game’s rider gets off the bike. He is a computer-animated, male-presenting racer in a tight green racing suit with red-orange shoulder pads and accents. A small helmet lies on the ground to his right. He runs straight toward the viewer with an angry, urgent expression, his brows sharply lowered and his mouth set. As he gets closer, his face fills the screen: pale, angular, low-polygon features, short brown hair, heavy dark eyebrows, and a scowling look. The edges of a television screen become visible around him, revealing that he is inside the game on an old-fashioned TV. The real-world setting is a warmly lit living room. An elderly white woman with short white hair sits in a cushioned chair, holding a gray PlayStation controller with both hands. She wears a soft white cardigan over a pink blouse or nightdress and looks intently toward the television, her face calm and slightly puzzled. The TV sits in front of her in a wooden entertainment unit or cabinet, with shelves and small decorative objects around it. On the TV screen, the animated racer’s large face is still glaring outward from the game world as if addressing her directly, while she remains seated and continues holding the controller. The product title then appears on a cloudy, silvery-white background with faint lightning-like streaks. In the center is a dark oval logo with gold text reading “Jet Moto 2.” After the logo, the game image returns briefly to the desert start line: the empty number 2 hover bike sits under the “GO!” sign while the green-suited racer stands beside it, with his helmet still on the ground. He moves near the bike as if urging action. The commercial ends back in the living room with the elderly woman holding the controller in her lap, looking forward with a faintly annoyed or confused expression.

The commercial opens in a dim, glossy nightclub-like space lit with red, blue, green, and amber lights. At center, an adult woman with long dark wavy hair poses beside a vertical metal pole on a raised stage. She wears a shiny black corset-style outfit with garter straps, dark thigh-high stockings, and high heels, with a large pale feather boa draped around both arms. One knee is bent and lifted, her foot resting near the pole or a low rail, while her hands settle at her waist. The floor reflects the colored lights, and curved neon lines and metal structures glow in the background, giving the setting a staged, cabaret atmosphere. She continues to pose slowly and confidently, shifting her weight as the feather boa hangs in thick plumes down either side of her body. Her head tilts downward at first, then she raises her face and turns slightly, looking off to one side. The vertical pole remains directly behind her, and the lights sweep across the dark club interior. As she straightens, her bent leg lowers out of the pose, and she stands more upright with both hands on her hips, framed by the soft, pale feathers. The image then changes to a black background with the title “Tomb Raider II” appearing in large, shimmering, icy white-blue letters. The words look distorted and electronic, as if made from static or flickering light, with the red Roman numeral “II” implied as part of the game title styling. A game scene follows, bordered by black around the image. A low-polygon animated woman, Lara Croft, stands in a bright outdoor field of tall grass. She has a brown braid, a teal sleeveless top, brown shorts, black gloves, and dark thigh holsters, with mountains and a blue sky with white clouds behind her. She holds her arms slightly out as if ready to move, looking alert in the open landscape. A brief close-up of abstract title graphics flashes by, with oversized pale letters and a bright blue-white streak cutting through them. The lettering is fragmented and hard to read, but it matches the metallic, electronic visual style of the Tomb Raider title. The gameplay footage then shows Lara in a sunlit architectural setting resembling an old European city, with cream-colored walls, balconies, arched windows, and a brick wall rising to the right. On-screen graphics appear: a “T” rating icon in the upper left, a PlayStation logo in the lower left, a colored health bar near the upper right, and the “TOMB RAIDER II” logo in orange and red at the lower right. Lara is seen from behind in the center, looking upward between the tall buildings as if navigating or climbing through the narrow space. The action shifts to a canal scene. A small motorboat speeds along greenish water between stone walls and wooden crates, sending white splashes outward. The boat heads toward and under a stone bridge in a tight passageway, with the same PlayStation, rating, health bar, and Tomb Raider II logo graphics remaining on-screen. Wooden boxes line the right side, and the water churns behind the boat as it passes through the canal. Next, Lara swims underwater in a blue-green ruin. Stone columns and walls rise around her, and her body is horizontal as she moves through the submerged space. A blue bar appears near the top right, suggesting an underwater status meter, while the Tomb Raider II branding remains at the lower right. The scene has a murky, ancient-temple look, with Lara moving between columns in the dim water. The gameplay moves indoors to a yellow-lit stone corridor with a checkered floor and carved walls. Lara runs forward into a dark opening at the far end, her small figure centered in the passage. The health bar is still visible near the top right, the rating icon remains at top left, the PlayStation logo at bottom left, and the Tomb Raider II logo at bottom right. The corridor grows darker as she advances, with columns and patterned stone panels sliding past on either side. The commercial ends back in the nightclub setting with the same woman in the black corset outfit and feather boa. She is shown closer now from about the waist up, standing with one hand at her hip and the other hand raised near her mouth or chin in a teasing pose. The club’s curved neon lines and blue light glow behind her. At the lower left, the white “EIDOS” logo appears, identifying the publisher, while the Tomb Raider II branding is partially visible at the lower right.

A young girl stands centered on a small stage in front of dark blue curtains, facing a tall black microphone. She has light skin, long brown hair in two braids, large clear-framed glasses, and a neat school-uniform look: a white collared shirt under a red plaid jumper, with large dark blue bows near her shoulders. She looks composed and confident, with a slight smile, as if performing in a spelling bee or school recital. While speaking, she gestures delicately with one hand near the microphone, then raises both hands to adjust her glasses at the temples. Her expression stays calm and self-assured as she finishes, looking straight ahead. The scene widens to reveal the stage more fully. An American flag stands on a pole at the left, blue curtains hang on both sides, and a square black mat or shadowed area lies on the wooden floor. Suddenly, an enormous gray cube descends into the center of the stage, filling the space where the girl had been. Its surface is mottled and metallic-looking, and a bright circular spotlight washes across its front face. The cube lands upright, massive and imposing, with the flag still visible beside it. The visuals then switch into the video game world: a glossy, dark, grid-like platform floating in black space. Large blocks form a moving wall ahead, made of gray cubes mixed with solid black cubes and glowing green cubes. A tiny human-like character, wearing a pale top and yellowish pants, stands on the reflective floor beside highlighted squares that change color from blue to red. The character runs along the grid as the block formations advance. A wider view shows multiple rows of blocks sliding forward like a wave across a long tiled pathway. The green cubes glow with a watery neon texture, the black cubes look dangerous and opaque, and the gray cubes have a cloudy metal sheen. A small ESRB rating box marked “K-A” appears in the lower right during the gameplay shots. The little game character navigates narrow spaces between towering cubes. In one moment, the character is hemmed in beside a high wall of blocks as a bright white block rises or flashes nearby, making the character appear very small against the massive cube surfaces. In another, the character runs along the edge of a stepped cube formation, close to glowing green blocks and a black cube set into the grid. As the blocks continue to shift, the character loses footing near the edge of the platform. The figure tips backward with arms raised and falls away from the tiled surface into black emptiness. Several views show the character tumbling between huge floating gray cubes, limbs splayed, shrinking against the surrounding block structures. The commercial returns to the stage. The giant gray cube now stands in the center under the circular spotlight, with mist or smoke drifting near its upper left edge. The American flag remains at the left, and the blue curtains frame the scene. Across the front face of the cube, black-and-white block lettering spells the game title: “Intelligent Qube.”

The commercial opens in a softly lit studio with a plain grey background. A young adult blonde woman with long, smooth, shoulder-length-to-chest-length hair leans forward with her forearms resting in front of her. She wears a black sleeveless top and a chunky silver watch. At first her hair swings across part of her face, then settles around her shoulders as she looks directly toward the viewer and speaks, calm and composed. The scene shifts to a young adult man with dark brown, rounded, medium-length hair standing in a shiny metallic corridor, surrounded by tall reflective silver panels. He wears a fitted black short-sleeved shirt. He playfully raises his arms, first striking an exaggerated pose and then flexing both biceps with a broad grin, visually matching the idea of strength. A different young adult man appears far away at the top of a long, pale, modern ramp between two white rails. He runs toward the viewer from a dark rectangular opening in a concrete-looking wall. As he comes closer, he is visible in a black suit with a light blue shirt and tie, his dark hair tousled by motion. He smiles and opens his arms wide, then pauses on the ramp with his arms stretched out. Another young adult man appears in a warm, softly lit interior. He has straight, medium-length light brown hair combed back from his face and wears a pale green shirt. He leans forward with his hands together near the lower edge of the image, looking directly ahead with a small, confident smile. The blonde woman returns in the grey studio, now closer. Her long hair lies sleekly over one shoulder and partly across her forehead. Her hands rest one over the other in front of her, the silver watch visible. She continues addressing the viewer, maintaining eye contact and a slight smile. Back in the modern city setting, the suited young man stands amid tall glass-and-steel skyscrapers. He points straight toward the viewer with an extended finger, smiling. He then bends slightly forward, still playful, before reappearing on the long white ramp. In a close view he lifts both hands toward his hair, indicating it with his fingers, and then, from farther back on the ramp, he turns his body and points outward again as if making a choice. A middle-aged man in a business suit appears in a more cramped, practical setting, holding a telephone receiver to his ear. He has light blond hair that is thinner on top. While speaking on the phone, he bends his head down and uses his free hand to smooth and pull his hair back over the crown of his head, revealing the scalp briefly before the hair is arranged more neatly. The Pantene Pro-V products are then introduced visually. Two white bottles stand upright in rippling blue water, surrounded by bright, icy reflections. Their labels read “PANTENE PRO-V,” with small colored Pro-V symbols and product text near the bottom. The bottles gleam as the water and light shimmer across their curved surfaces, then the image washes into bright white. A dark, backlit shower scene follows. A person’s bare shoulders and head are seen from behind under falling water. Both hands massage the scalp through wet hair as droplets sparkle against the dark background. The commercial then uses a stylized hair-care demonstration. Golden, translucent capsule-like shapes float around enlarged brown hair strands. They drift between the strands, touch the shafts, and seem to attach or sink into them. The hair strands are shown at extreme magnification, with rough, scale-like edges visible at first. As the golden capsules move along the strands, the surfaces appear smoother and more uniform. The capsules continue traveling among many parallel strands, suggesting treatment moving through the hair from near the base toward the tip. The imagery returns to people with healthy-looking hair. A young man with dark brown hair is first seen softly out of focus in a bright interior, resting his chin or hands together in front of him; as the focus clears, he smiles gently. Another young man with blond hair appears in close view, his hair neatly swept back with a glossy shine as he smiles and looks downward. Then a cheerful young red-haired boy sits on the shoulders of a smiling adult man. The boy, wearing a pale T-shirt, holds and ruffles the man’s hair with both hands while both laugh, framed by a bright, airy room with tall windows. A larger product display appears: several white Pantene Pro-V bottles stand in shallow, rippling water. Two main bottles are centered in front, one tall and cylindrical and one shorter with a rounded top, with additional bottles blurred behind them. The “PANTENE PRO-V” name is clearly printed in black on the front labels, and small colored Pro-V icons mark the different products. Water droplets and bright reflections cover the packaging, giving the bottles a cool, clean, glossy look. A close view of a blond young man follows against a warm amber background. He bends his head forward and then tosses his hair back, the hair sweeping in a bright arc. He runs a hand through the front, and the hair settles smoothly with a visible shine. White on-screen text appears across the upper left to upper center: “For hair so healthy it shines.” The final image brings together the blonde woman from the opening and the light-brown-haired young man. They are close together in the soft grey studio lighting. He stands slightly behind and to her left, smiling warmly at her, while she faces forward with her long blonde hair smooth around her shoulders. She smiles toward the viewer as the commercial ends.

A red car tries to squeeze into a tight parking space along a curb on a city street, seen from high above. A black car is parked at one end of the space and another red car is parked at the other, leaving very little room. The moving red car has a bright yellow sign on its roof, suggesting a learner or driving-test situation, though the small writing is not clearly readable. It inches forward and back at awkward angles, getting extremely close to the parked cars. As it struggles into the space, its front end becomes visibly crumpled and dented, and the car ends up wedged near the curb and the other red car. The yellow roof sign slips out of place and appears on the windshield as the damaged car finally sits crookedly in the narrow gap. The scene abruptly changes to fast, colorful video-game imagery. A fiery red and yellow game scene fills the screen, followed by underwater or aquatic game footage with a dark interface bar along the bottom showing numbers and a timer. Small characters move through pale blue water, with score-like numbers at the bottom right. More game footage follows: a side-view action game with a cartoonish hero near a platform, rocky shapes in the background, and enemies around him. A blue, metallic “SEGA CHANNEL” logo appears over the gameplay, accompanied by a small stylized mascot figure holding a flag. The logo then expands into a large close-up of the words “SEGA CHANNEL” in bold blue and silver letters. A montage emphasizes games and access. In one game screen, large red block letters spelling “GAMES” appear over colorful gameplay with round blue objects on a green-and-yellow course. Another game shows Sonic, the small blue hedgehog character, in an isometric stone-walled room with a checkered blue-and-yellow floor; “RINGS 33” is visible at the upper left while Sonic stands near a patterned floor tile. The commercial then shows visual symbols for things being eliminated. A black-and-white street or public waiting scene appears with a crowd of people, overlaid by big blue letters reading “LINES.” A red prohibition circle with a diagonal slash drops over the word, crossing it out. Next, a roadside “SPEED LIMIT” sign fills the background while the blue word “LIMITS” sits across it; again, a red no-symbol crosses it out. Then a black-and-white image of someone handling money or papers at a counter appears with large blue words “LATE FEES,” which are also covered by the red circle-and-slash symbol. More gameplay appears behind large yellow text reading “UNLIMITED PLAY.” One background is a fighting game with two characters facing each other in an arena, health bars and a timer across the top. Another background shows a flying creature, like a pterodactyl, moving across a game screen. The same little flag-holding mascot appears near the lower left as part of the graphic design. The montage continues into another game with a blue watery background and a character moving along a slanted rope or vine; the “SEGA CHANNEL” logo overlays it and then fills the screen on a bright green-and-yellow graphic background. A price message appears over more game footage. Large hot-pink text reads “LESS THAN $15,” first over a fighting game screen and then over a board-game-like screen with colored squares around the edge. The small mascot reappears in pink, holding up its flag beside the price text. The call-to-action section uses huge red letters reading “CALL NOW.” The words first appear on a plain light background with the blue mascot standing in front of them, then over a comic-book-style game screen. A title screen for “COMIX ZONE” appears, showing a muscular blond comic character lunging forward, with “START” and “OPTIONS” beneath the title. The final product card is a bright yellow screen with the blue-and-silver “SEGA CHANNEL” logo on the right and the flag-holding mascot on the left. Beneath it, dark text reads, “The only way to get it is to GET it!” Afterward, a small spinning cartoon character appears briefly against a grey static-like background, then the final red ordering screen appears. It shows the Sega Channel mascot in yellow behind white text: “To order call InterMedia 247-2183” and “Only $11.95/month.” Fine-print copyright and trademark text runs along the bottom.

A broad green park appears under a canopy of large leafy trees. Small groups of people walk across the grass in the distance, dressed in light-coloured clothing, giving the scene a calm, leisurely, old-fashioned feel. The setting shifts closer to two very young children seated side by side in a white pram or carriage on the grass. Both wear navy-and-white sailor-style outfits with wide white collars and round white sailor hats trimmed in dark piping. One fair-haired toddler faces slightly toward the camera, cheeks rosy, while the other is seen mostly from behind. They sit quietly, looking at each other and down into the pram. The imagery changes abruptly to a muddy rugby match. Adult players in dark and yellow jerseys rush across a wet, grassy field. A player in a dark uniform clutches a pale rugby ball against his chest as other players close in around him. He drops and slides through mud, landing on his side while a player in yellow reaches toward him. The action is crowded, fast, and physical, with splashes of mud and blurred legs moving around the tackled player. A quieter river scene follows. A narrow wooden rowboat floats on calm water beside reeds and an old brick or stone building. One person, wearing a cap and dark coat, sits toward the back and rows with oars. A Texaco gas station sits beyond a wide, divided roadway in a dry, open landscape under warm, late-day light. He walks across one side of the pavement, steps over or around the center divider, and continues toward the opposite side, visually turning the phrase “going the extra mile” into a literal journey across a huge span of road. Returning to the white coupe, he opens the car’s fuel door and brings the nozzle to the gas tank. A hazy, sepia-toned aerial view opens over a dense city by the water. Tall buildings cluster tightly together, with piers, roads, and a patch of parkland visible around the edge of the island. Behind it are breakfast-table items, including a white pitcher and plates. The coffee fills the cup as the warm kitchen light catches the white ceramic. In a small home kitchen, a family sits around the same checked tablecloth. A woman in a yellow apron over a white blouse stands and serves from a dark blue coffee pot. Around the table are a middle-aged man in a patterned dark shirt, a young woman or teenage girl in a dark top, and a boy or teenage boy in a light shirt. They hold cups and look toward one another, smiling and talking. After serving, the woman carries the blue pot away from the table toward the stove area. She sets or holds the pot near a stovetop, where the Brim can is visible again on a shelf beside white containers, reinforcing the product’s place in the kitchen. The scene shifts to a bright diner or lunch counter. A young adult waitress with light hair pulled back wears a pale short-sleeved uniform blouse. She stands behind or beside the counter with a coffee pot in her hand, smiling at several adult men seated in a row. The men wear casual work clothes and hats, including cowboy-style hats and caps. Some hold cups close to their mouths, drinking; others look toward the waitress. The counter is lined with cups, small containers, and reflective metal surfaces, giving the space the look of a busy café. A woman outdoors drinks from a small brown mug while leaning against a wall near a blue-gray door with window bars. She has dark hair pulled back and wears a light yellow top or jacket. They lean in closely, talking across a small vase of flowers at the center of the table. Behind them, another person sits and drinks. A server in an apron passes in the foreground carrying a tray or cups, briefly blocking part of the couple from view. The people at the table fade into a wide night view of a city across water. The skyline is bright with countless lights, reflected in the dark bay. A bridge or roadway with a line of lights stretches across the lower part of the scene, and the city glows under a cloudy sky. The labels show the large “brim” name, with “regular grind” and “decaffeinated coffee” visible on the can. Steam rises clearly from the mug, and the packages stand upright next to it, forming the closing image of Brim decaffeinated coffee ready to drink.

The commercial begins in black and white with a San Francisco landmark: a large rooftop sign spelling “SAN FRANCISCO” stretches across the top of a building, with a tall clock tower rising at the left. The side of the cable car passes close by, and a small “Pepsi” sign or advertisement is visible on the car’s side. A large street sign or billboard then fills the view with the words “GROOM & CLEAN” in huge block letters. Beneath it, smaller text reads “clear cleansing hair grooming — without grease,” and “SAN FRANCISCO” is visible below the sign. The young couple continues smiling on the moving cable car, looking off to the side as if reacting to the city around them. The imagery becomes bright and hazy, with the man and woman partly silhouetted against buildings and sunlight. Then a young man appears in a convertible, seen from the side inside the car. The driver sits at the front, with other passengers seated behind, all moving through streets lined with apartment buildings. The car rolls along in the sunshine, the passengers’ hair and clothing stirred by the open air. A close-up shows a man grooming his hair. His head is tilted down, and a hand draws a comb through the front and side of his dark hair. The hair looks wet or glossy but orderly, with comb lines visible as the teeth pass through. The comb moves steadily from the front hairline toward the side, shaping the hair into a smooth natural wave. The close-up emphasizes the hair’s texture: controlled, shiny, and clean-looking rather than heavy. The setting shifts to the Golden Gate Bridge and rocky shoreline. A young woman in the same mermaid-like costume sits on large dark rocks beside churning water. The bridge towers and cables stretch behind her, and waves break white against the rocks in the foreground. She holds a tube or small product container near her chest as if presenting or discussing it. Large white on-screen words appear beside her: “water active.” She smiles and looks toward the viewer while the bridge structure frames the background. The product demonstration begins in close-up. A hand holds the Groom & Clean tube and squeezes a dark, glossy ribbon of hair dressing into an open palm. The “water active” words remain on screen. The product sits on the skin like a small curved strip of gel. The hand then moves into water. As the palm swishes through the surface, the gel mixes with the water, creating ripples, bubbles, and a foamy-looking swirl. The product appears to disperse and wash away rather than stay greasy. After several passes through the water, the palm is shown open and clean, with the “water active” text still visible beside it. The grooming demonstration continues with another close-up of the man’s head. Hands and a comb work through his damp-looking hair, smoothing it down and guiding it into shape. Bold white words appear over the hair: “cleans away dirt dandruff.” The comb moves along the side and top of the head while fingers press and separate the hair near the temple. The words remain centered over the dark hair as the combing continues, visually linking the wet-combing action with cleansing. The commercial returns to the convertible by the water. A young man with neatly groomed dark hair sits close beside a young woman wearing a light headscarf tied around her hair. They smile and relax together, with water shimmering behind them. The man’s hair remains smooth and controlled despite the outdoor setting. The woman turns her face slightly upward and away, smiling calmly as the car or boat-like setting moves near the bay. A sailboat appears on the water with the Golden Gate Bridge in the background. Its large sail has bold curved panels and numbers near the top. The boat moves across choppy water, leaning slightly with the wind. The scene then shifts to two young adults standing on a rocky slope near a large round mechanical or nautical object at the left edge, possibly part of boating equipment. The woman wears a light outfit and moves rhythmically, facing a man in a light shirt and dark trousers. They gesture and dance casually together, smiling and turning toward each other in the open air. The man is then shown in close profile against a bright sky, smiling as he turns his head. His short hair stays neatly in place, shaped close to the head. The mermaid figure returns, swinging again from the hanging net over the bay. She reclines in the net with her glittering tail trailing through the water, then raises herself, laughs, and flicks the tail so it splashes. In a wider silhouette, she hangs high above the water with the Golden Gate Bridge off to the left, her body and tail forming a curved shape inside the net. She swings back and forth, then leans toward the camera, smiling and waving one arm. Her long hair falls around her face, and the city waterfront blurs behind her. The commercial ends by returning to the product tube. Groom & Clean lies diagonally across the wet, flowing surface again, with water moving beneath it. The brand name “GROOM & CLEAN” dominates the label, and the smaller phrase “hair grooming — without grease” is visible near the bottom, reinforcing the product’s clean, water-soluble presentation.

The commercial opens in a reddish, softly tinted street scene lined with old-fashioned telephone booths. The word “TELEPHONE” appears above each booth. Parked cars fill the foreground, their rounded roofs and windshields framing a heavyset, middle-aged man in a dark suit and brimmed hat as he walks toward the center booth. He pauses with his back partly to us, then turns slightly sideways near the booth door. He raises a large dark briefcase or folder up in front of him as if trying to manage it in the tight space, his body close to the booth entrance. A passerby in a lighter jacket briefly crosses in front, partially blocking the view. The scene changes to a tight domestic or public seating area with padded, tufted chair backs on both sides. A woman in a fitted dress is seen mostly from the waist and hips as she tries to move through a narrow gap between the upholstered chairs. The chairs have pale, buttoned cushions with rows of dark nailhead trim. Her skirt brushes close to both sides, emphasizing how little room there is as she squeezes through. Inside a car, the focus is on a large-bodied person in the driver’s seat. The steering wheel sits close to the person’s abdomen, leaving very little space between belly and wheel. The person’s hands are near the wheel, and the dashboard and front seat frame the cramped interior. Another vehicle interior follows: a woman in a pale hat and light coat sits upright, while a larger figure passes very close in the foreground, blocking part of her and pressing through the tight aisle or seating area. She turns her face downward and to the side, looking uncomfortable or crowded as the other body moves past the back of her seat. A bathroom appears next. A striped towel hangs on a rack beside a shower or glass door. The door slides open, revealing a shirtless, heavyset man wrapped in a towel around his waist. Only his torso and hips are shown at first. He stands very close to the shower doorframe, his abdomen nearly touching the edge, again making the space look narrow. The towel sits low around his waist, and the reddish lighting highlights the curve of his stomach as he shifts within the doorway. At a dining table, a woman in a short-sleeved dress sits on a white folding chair. The view centers on her side and lap as she leans toward the tabletop. Her hips fill the small chair, and the thin folding legs and back supports are visible around her. She reaches toward the table with one hand, where dishes and glassware are partly visible. As she adjusts herself and leans forward, the chair looks undersized beneath her. In a narrow aisle lined with shelves full of books, two adults are squeezed back-to-back. A blonde, middle-aged woman in a light suit stands on the left, and a heavyset man in a dark suit stands on the right, facing the bookshelves. Their backs press together in the cramped passage. The woman glances over her shoulder with a strained, annoyed expression, while the man looks toward the books with a faint, awkward smile. They both shift slightly, but neither has much room to move. Back outside among parked cars, a heavyset man in a dark suit is wedged between two vehicles: a darker car on the left and a pale car on the right. He raises a large rectangular briefcase above his head, then lowers it awkwardly as he tries to get himself into the narrow space by the car door. His shoulders and torso press close to the pale car’s side. He bends and twists, struggling to fit himself and the briefcase into the car. Eventually the dark car door stands open, then closes, leaving only the vehicles in view. An elevator doorway appears crowded with people. A short, balding, middle-aged man in a dark suit and narrow tie stands at the front, facing outward. Behind him are several passengers packed closely together: a woman in a red coat with a pale collar, a man in a light trench coat, another man in a hat, and other partially visible faces. The balding man lowers his head and steps or shuffles forward slightly, but the group remains tightly pressed together behind him. He looks ahead with a resigned, neutral expression while the others watch or look around. The sliding elevator door begins to close from the right, narrowing the opening until the crowded group is almost completely hidden. The visual focus then shifts to the product demonstration. A white teacup filled with a dark hot drink sits on a saucer, with a small spoon resting beside it. Above the cup, a pointed white dispenser tip hovers over the surface, suggesting drops of sweetener being added. A hand then brings in a tall, clear, tapered bottle and sets it beside the cup. The bottle has a red lower section, a pale oval label, and a long white pointed cap. The label reads “Sucaryl,” with small icons underneath that resemble food and drink items, such as a cup, fruit, and a tall glass. A hand in a jacket sleeve steadies the Sucaryl bottle next to the cup, then points toward the label and the cup, drawing attention between the sweetener and the drink. The view moves closer to the label so the word “Sucaryl” fills most of the image. A finger points near the bottle as the view travels upward along the container’s shape, from its wider body to its narrow neck and long, thin, pointed white cap. The finger reaches the tip and presses or taps near it, emphasizing the sharp, slender point. Finally, the bottle stands upright on the left beside the cup on the right. The Sucaryl label remains visible, and the cup of dark drink sits on its saucer with the spoon nearby. A hand reaches to the cup, touches the handle, and gently lifts it from the saucer, leaving the tall, pointed Sucaryl bottle standing prominently beside it.

A young blonde flight attendant in a bright orange United uniform and matching pillbox-style cap fills the screen. She wears white gloves and holds a pale balloon close to her mouth, inflating it. The “Come fly with me...” button appears again, now on a white uniform, followed by another smiling female attendant in a white cap and dark-and-white uniform.
