At dawn, a warm, sunlit bedroom is shown with tall windows and sheer white curtains glowing orange from the morning light. A large bed with white bedding fills the room, and a person lies mostly hidden under the covers, only a head visible near the right side. A small bedside table, lamp, chair, and a neat, cozy arrangement of furniture create a lived-in home atmosphere. Over the bedroom scene, the product name appears in white and red: “Kellogg’s Nutri-Grain Bars.” The person in bed stirs and sits up abruptly under the white comforter, suggesting a rushed start to the morning. The scene moves into a bright bathroom with pale walls, a sink, mirror, towels on a rail, and louvered windows throwing strong bands of sunlight across the room. A light-skinned adult man, likely in his thirties, stands in a white dress shirt and dark trousers, hurriedly working at a dark tie around his neck. His short brown hair is neatly styled, but his posture is tense and bent forward toward the mirror as if trying to get ready quickly. He keeps one hand at his collar and tie, glancing toward the doorway with a worried, distracted expression. A light-skinned adult woman, also likely in her thirties, appears in a doorway. She has voluminous curly brown hair, round earrings, and a polished work outfit in a warm tan or reddish-brown color. She raises both hands slightly in a calming or “wait” gesture, then moves briskly past the doorway. Her expression is alert but upbeat, and she seems to be taking charge of the hurried morning. In the kitchen, morning light streams through large windows and a glass-paned back door. The room is bright and domestic, with a refrigerator on the left, white cabinetry, a counter or small table on the right, and papers or work items near an open cereal-bar box. The woman stands by the counter holding a red-wrapped bar. The man, now wearing a dark suit jacket over his white shirt with a patterned tie, steps in beside her. She offers him the bar, and he looks down at it as he takes it, still appearing preoccupied. The product is then shown prominently. A white box with large red lettering reads “Kellogg’s Nutri-Grain,” with pictures of strawberries and bars filled with red fruit. Smaller text on the front says “Made with real fruit” and “No preservatives,” and the flavor shown is “Strawberry.” A hand reaches into the open box and pulls out a red individual wrapper. The wrapper itself reads “Kellogg’s Nutri-Grain Cereal Bar Strawberry” in large white letters on a red background. The woman is shown in close view as she speaks, smiling and looking toward the man. Her curled hair catches the backlight, and her gold-toned earrings are visible. She appears confident and encouraging, as if explaining the bar to him. Fingers tear open the red wrapper, peeling it back to reveal a golden-brown rectangular bar with a soft, textured crust. As more of the wrapper is pulled down, the baked crust is shown close up, with a reddish fruit filling visible along the edge. The bar is displayed even more closely: its tan, grainy surface fills the view, held between fingers at both ends. A crack opens through the middle of the crust, widening to reveal a moist red strawberry filling inside. Small copyright text appears at the lower right during this product close-up: “© 1991 Kellogg Company” and “® Kellogg Company.” Back in the kitchen, the man bites into the partly unwrapped Nutri-Grain bar. His face tightens briefly as he takes the bite, then he chews, his expression shifting from skepticism to approval. He looks forward with a more settled, pleased face, as if surprised that he likes it. The kitchen scene returns to both adults. The woman, still in her tan suit, swings a matching shoulder bag onto her arm and begins getting ready to leave. The man stands by the counter with the open Nutri-Grain box in front of him, holding the red-wrapped bar in one hand and chewing. He gestures and looks toward her while she adjusts her purse strap. She leans toward the counter and pulls out or opens a large tan work bag or portfolio with a dotted pattern, checking inside as if gathering papers for the day. The man fusses with his suit jacket and tie, still holding the bar, while the box remains clearly visible on the counter between them. The woman finishes closing or arranging the large bag and moves toward the door. The man turns with her, both now facing the glass-paned exit. She carries her shoulder bag, and he follows with the bar still in hand. The kitchen remains bathed in soft morning light, reinforcing the sense of a busy weekday departure. The commercial ends with a clean product display against a dark background: the white Kellogg’s Nutri-Grain Cereal Bars box, strawberry flavor, with red strawberries and images of the golden bars with red filling on the front. Across the bottom, large white text reads, “Start your morning off right.”

A slim young adult man stands on a narrow stone ledge in front of a grand public building with tall pale columns and vertical grooves. Strong sunlight casts hard shadows across the stone. He has light skin and medium-length brown hair that swings around his face. He wears a dark long-sleeved shirt, loose light-blue jeans with a torn knee, heavy brown shoes, and a red plaid shirt tied around his waist. He moves restlessly and dramatically, stepping along the ledge, throwing his arms up, and whipping his hair as if passionately arguing with someone offscreen. His face fills the view as he leans forward, scowling and speaking directly outward. His hair blows across his forehead and cheeks. He points and jabs with his hand, his mouth wide open, brows pulled tight, giving the impression of an intense rant. He turns side-on beside the columns, still gesturing with one finger, then faces forward again, glaring and speaking with exaggerated urgency. He becomes even more theatrical. With the massive columns towering behind him, he grabs both sides of his head, fingers buried in his hair, bending forward and grimacing as if overwhelmed. His hair flies loose as he shakes his head. He crouches low on the ledge, then springs up into a wide-legged stance, hands clasped over his head, before settling back into a front-facing position. He continues pacing and gesturing, sometimes looking straight ahead, sometimes down and to the side, his expression shifting between anger, alarm, and defiance. After a burst of frantic motion, he pauses and smooths his hair back with one hand, pulling it away from his face. His posture dips, and he looks downward, still tense. He then swings back into view with his hair partly covering one side of his face, speaking sharply again. A young adult woman appears behind him near a dark doorway between the columns. She has light skin, short wavy auburn hair, and wears a pale gray top under a black strappy dress or camisole, with a black choker necklace and small pendant. She stands calmly behind and slightly to his left while he continues ranting in the foreground. As she steps closer, her expression is composed and matter-of-fact. She raises a small white square packet in her hand, holding it near his shoulder level as if presenting it to him. The man notices the packet and looks down at it. The view shifts to the packet held between fingers: it is a white foil condom wrapper with the brand name “Sheik” printed in large purple script, and smaller text reading “1 Condom.” Another hand steadies or touches the packet, making the product name clearly visible. The packet is small, square, and crinkled at the edges. Back beside the columns, the woman faces outward with a calm, slightly knowing look, while the man stands to her right, now focused on the packet in his hand. She appears to have made her point. He studies the wrapper, his earlier defiance giving way to surprise. As the woman moves out of the foreground, he remains holding the Sheik packet, looking after her and then back at it. His expression changes dramatically. He brightens, eyes widening and mouth opening in sudden enthusiasm. Still clutching the packet, he gestures excitedly with his free hand and repeatedly holds the wrapper up toward the viewer. He smooths his hair back again, grinning and animated, then waves the packet as if proudly showing it off. The anger and resistance from earlier are replaced by eager approval. He continues speaking rapidly and enthusiastically, the condom packet flashing in his hand as he points it forward. His hair flips around with his movement, and he bounces in place on the ledge. In the final moment, he is again shown full-body against the tall stone columns, standing on the ledge with the red plaid shirt tied at his waist, raising both arms triumphantly above his shoulders.

The commercial opens on an intense close view of a reddish-brown bulldog’s face, filling almost the entire screen. The dog has a broad, wrinkled forehead, dark eyes, a black nose, drooping jowls, and a slightly open mouth showing small lower teeth. A shiny collar is partly visible near the bottom edges. Small white legal text appears at the lower right, including “AVAILABLE IN MOST AREAS” and “© 1995 PLANK ROAD BREWERY MILWAUKEE, WI.” The image shifts to a frosty Red Dog beer bottle standing in front of a warm-toned brick wall. The bottle is coated with crushed ice and condensation. Its label features a black diamond with large white letters spelling “RED DOG” around a red bulldog head illustration. The label also includes cursive and banner-style text, including “Beer” and “Uncommonly Smooth.” The bottle is presented like a chilled product display, with ice sparkling along its shoulders and label. The focus moves into close details of the label. The word “Premium,” written in dark blue cursive on a pale cream background, fills the screen. Water and foam-like liquid wash across the label surface, sometimes blurring the letters, then revealing them again. Red and blue border stripes slide through the composition as droplets bead and run over the glossy paper. The visuals become an amber, beer-colored world of bubbles and condensation. Golden liquid and water droplets cling to a glassy surface, with streams running downward through a field of tiny bubbles. A round, icy bottle-top detail bearing the red bulldog emblem appears, then the view moves to the mouth of a bottle. Pale foam and golden beer surge outward from the neck, filling the screen with a rushing, frothy texture. The frosted Red Dog label returns at an angle, tilted across the brick background, its red bulldog head and bold “RED DOG” lettering partially covered by ice crystals. Inside a glowing amber circular shape, beer swirls like a whirlpool, lit with bright gold highlights. The image then returns to the label, emphasizing the red banner reading “Uncommonly Smooth” and the cursive words “Plank Road Brewery” below it. The label remains wet and icy, with droplets and frost catching the light. A tall glass of golden lager appears, covered in condensation. Thick white foam gathers at the top and begins to flow over the rim, sliding down the front in a creamy ribbon between the cold, bubbled sides of the glass. The warm brick wall remains behind it, giving the scene a pub-like or cellar-like atmosphere. An award medal and a red, white, and blue ribbon appear among the beer foam. On a black band across the bottom of the screen, white typewriter-style text reads, “Gold Medal Winner.” Small white text near the upper left reads “BEST AMERICAN LAGER, 1995.” Foam spreads around the medal and ribbon, and the bottom text changes to “Great American Beer Festival.” The medal is shown in close detail against a glowing amber background, its round gold surface and striped ribbon moving through splashes and bubbles. The medal and ribbon settle visually into a frothy beer scene, with white foam clinging to the metal and ribbon loops. The imagery returns to the cold glass, now crowned with a smooth, rounded head of foam. The beer beneath is a clear golden amber, covered with fine condensation droplets. The label reappears again in close-up, highlighting the red “Uncommonly Smooth” banner over the pale label and the red bulldog emblem above it. At the end, the product is arranged in a final still-life display: a chilled Red Dog bottle stands on the left, its frosted label facing forward, and a tall glass of golden beer stands on the right, overflowing slightly with thick white foam down one side. A red, white, and blue ribbon from the medal rests beside the glass. The background is the same warm brick wall. Across the bottom black band, large white typewriter-style text reads, “You are your own dog.”

The commercial opens in a warmly lit dining room during a children’s birthday party. Several young children sit around a table covered with plates and clear glasses of red drink. In the center is a decorated birthday cake with a small lit candle, and pink balloons float in the background near a bright window with shutters. A little child with curly blond hair leans close to the cake, facing the candle, while a girl with pigtails sits beside them. Suddenly, as the children react and raise their hands, a burst of tiny cake crumbs, sprinkles, or party debris showers upward and rains down over the curly-haired child’s head and the tabletop. The cake remains in the middle, but the area around it looks messy, with particles falling through the warm light. The scene changes to a close view of a wooden floor under a chair. Small pale crumbs are scattered across the floorboards near a white chair leg. A dark, handheld cordless vacuum with a narrow nozzle is lowered toward the mess. The nozzle glides over the crumbs, drawing them up from the floor in a small, controlled path, reaching close to the chair leg where a larger vacuum would be awkward. A small tan puppy appears next, standing in a softly lit room. It walks toward a blue food bowl placed on a black-and-white checkered kitchen floor. The bowl is heaped with dry dog food, and some pieces spill over the rim. The puppy lies down and begins eating near the bowl. In a closer view, the dry food is piled high, then spills down over the side, creating a scatter of kibble on the floor. A dark DustBuster-style vacuum is shown hanging vertically on a wall-mounted charging bracket. A hand in a coral or pink sleeve reaches in and lifts the compact vacuum away from the holder. Back on the checkered kitchen floor, an adult woman in a loose coral top kneels beside the puppy. She pets the puppy with one hand while holding the cordless vacuum in the other. The puppy keeps eating from the blue bowl, and the woman brings the vacuum nozzle to the spilled kibble, cleaning the small pile beside the bowl without disturbing the dog. The setting then shifts to a bright kitchen or dining area with a baby seated in a high chair. The baby, with very light blond hair, wears a teal shirt under light overalls and smiles happily. On the high-chair tray is a small blue cup filled with snack pieces. A closer view shows the cup full of finger-sized snacks. Some of the snacks are later scattered on the floor nearby. A woman with dark hair pulled back, wearing a white-and-dark striped top and dark pants, crouches on the floor beside the high chair. The baby remains seated to the right, watching from the tray area. The woman uses the same dark handheld vacuum to pick up the scattered snack pieces from the pale floor. She guides the nozzle along the floor in short passes, collecting the small bits near a chair leg and beneath the high chair. As the mess disappears, she looks up toward the baby and smiles. At the end, the vacuum is returned to its wall-mounted holder. The dark, tapered body of the handheld cleaner hangs neatly against a light wall, with the product name visible on the front. Large on-screen text appears across the bottom reading “BLACK & DECKER,” accompanied by the brand’s geometric logo, while a hand steadies the vacuum on the charging bracket.

A balding, middle-aged man in a light blue dress shirt and patterned tie hurries up to an outdoor ATM set into a brick wall. Above the machine are the Mastercard overlapping red-and-yellow circles and a blue “CIRRUS” sign. He turns toward a younger man with thick curly hair, wearing a dark leather jacket over a green shirt. The younger man stands beside the ATM holding a small stack of dollar bills, while the balding man holds up a small greenish card as if asking for help. Pedestrians pass between them. The curly-haired man looks down at the card, then out to the side with a doubtful, uncertain expression, still clutching his cash. Both men end up looking off in the same direction, as if trying to figure out where to go. On another sidewalk, near an ATM mounted in a wall, two adults lean toward an elderly woman seated low beside a parked car. One person in a red patterned top points firmly into the distance, while another person in a beige vest leans in close and points as well. The elderly woman looks up at them as they appear to give complicated directions. The balding man is then seated in a car with the top down, holding up the same greenish card near his face. He smiles hopefully toward someone outside the car. A young woman with short dark hair, a bright pink hair scrunchie, hoop earrings, and a blue jacket faces him while holding a large brown paper grocery bag with a baguette sticking out. A passerby briefly blocks the view. The woman smiles at first, then looks more concerned and uncertain, hugging the bag to her chest and gesturing with one hand as if she does not know the answer. The man studies the card, flips it slightly in his fingers, and looks back up, still waiting for help. He next sits on the hood of a red car beside a cyclist in a white helmet, purple cycling shirt, black gloves, and cycling gear. Behind them is a roadside diner with large roof letters spelling part of “DINER.” The balding man holds folded papers or maps in his lap, while the cyclist grips the handlebars and points off to the side, apparently adding another set of directions. The man looks away in the direction indicated. A wide outdoor view shows a pale green metal truss bridge spanning calm water, with trees behind it. A small red car drives across the bridge, emphasizing that the search has taken him well away from the city streets. Back on a sunny sidewalk, the balding man bends forward beside a small elderly woman wearing a straw hat, large eyeglasses, a patterned blouse, and a vest. She gestures emphatically with one finger raised, then points outward and downward, giving a long, detailed explanation. The man listens with a serious, slightly weary expression, leaning in close at her height. She adjusts her glasses, waves her hand, and continues pointing, while pedestrians move in soft focus behind them along a tree-lined street. The focus shifts to the product in use. A hand holds a gray Mastercard card close to an ATM card slot. The card clearly shows the blue “MasterCard” name and the red-and-yellow Mastercard circles. The hand slides the card into the horizontal slot. The card goes partway in, with the logo still visible, then disappears deeper into the machine. Another ATM is shown with the Mastercard and CIRRUS logos below its screen and keypad. A hand retrieves a stack of cash from the cash dispenser, then moves to press buttons on the keypad. At the ATM, the balding man now stands beside a young woman with shoulder-length brown hair wearing a peach-colored blouse. They are outside a light-colored building with a small domed tower visible against a bright blue sky. The man holds up the greenish card near his chest while the woman holds cash. They look at each other, then she looks upward and points confidently into the distance, as if indicating a much simpler solution or location. The man watches her, appearing relieved but still slightly bemused. The image blends back to the elderly woman and the balding man on the sidewalk. White text appears along the lower part of the screen reading “MASTER THE MOMENT,” and the Mastercard overlapping red-and-yellow circles logo appears at the lower right with the “MasterCard” name. The elderly woman continues talking and gesturing with one raised finger, while the man leans beside her and eventually dips his head downward, as if exhausted by all the complicated directions.

A young blonde woman in a white top and dark skirt moves through a dim, sunlit interior with large windowpanes behind her. Warm light cuts across her clothing and hair as she lifts or adjusts a dark bag and heads toward a doorway. She passes behind an old-fashioned metal elevator or security gate with crisscrossing vertical bars, her figure broken into strips by the lattice. In the warm, shadowy space, faces are seen through the bars, close and partially blurred, giving the moment an intimate, fleeting feel. A black Sony camcorder appears resting on a surface, propped on a small support with its strap draped underneath. The front lens is prominent, and the white “SONY” name is visible on the upper part of the device. The blonde woman looks down toward it with a soft smile that grows into a broad, delighted grin, her face warmly lit from below and her loose hair glowing around her cheeks. A young man with short light hair, wearing a dark sweater, waits near a glass door in a bright lobby. He leans casually with one arm raised against the doorframe and smiles with a dimpled expression. The blonde woman, now in a dark jacket over her outfit and carrying a bag, approaches him. He holds the door open as she walks through, and sunlight spills across the floor and glass behind them. Outside, the blonde woman is seen in bright glare and reflections, now holding the compact camcorder up to her eye. The black body and lens fill part of the view, and the “SONY” lettering appears large across the side or strap as she records. Her silhouette and hair are backlit, making her profile and the camcorder stand out against a pale, hazy background. The setting shifts to a busy city sidewalk in daylight. People in casual 1990s clothing pass along storefront windows, and a red convertible is parked along the curb in the foreground. A man in a black hat and dark clothes stands near the storefront while several pedestrians move past him. The atmosphere is public and social, with people gathering and flowing in different directions. At an outdoor café, several young adults sit and stand around small tables. A woman with long, curly dark hair in a bright red top laughs openly at the table. Behind and beside her, the blonde woman and other friends are visible in the sunlight. A blond young man in a dark sweater stands outside the café area holding the Sony camcorder in one hand, presenting it casually to the group. The camcorder is small enough to rest in his palm, with its lens barrel and rectangular body clearly visible. Another young man in a black leather jacket raises the camcorder to his eye and records, holding it close to his face with both hands. The blond woman and the blond man then stand together, his arm around her shoulders. They smile at each other and toward the person filming, appearing relaxed and affectionate in the bright outdoor light. A close view of the camcorder pressed to someone’s eye shows the “SONY” name in white on the black casing. The round eyepiece sits against the user’s face, and the lens projects forward below it. The person squints slightly while filming, emphasizing the camcorder as a handheld, personal device. The blond man then turns with the camcorder in one hand and gestures broadly with both arms, as if calling friends together. Around the café tables, people look toward him. A seated dark-haired woman watches from behind a small table with cups, while more friends gather nearby. The blonde woman stands close to a bearded man in denim, and a curly-haired woman in a red top joins them; they cluster shoulder to shoulder, smiling and leaning in for the camcorder. Another young couple, a short-haired man in layered casual clothes and the curly-haired woman, smile side by side as they look toward the person recording. The final image changes to a blue-toned evening or nighttime setting. In the distance, a couple stands together against the backdrop of a large apartment building. The man raises the small camcorder high in one hand while holding the woman close. Large translucent text reading “Handycam.” stretches across the center of the image. Then the couple fills the view: the blonde woman nestles against the blond man’s shoulder, both wrapped close together in dim blue light. Their expressions are calm and affectionate; their eyes close briefly, then open as they look toward the viewer, ending with a quiet, intimate portrait of the two of them.

A quiet golf course appears first: broad green fairways, a pond in the foreground reflecting the sky, and trees scattered across the landscape. The golfer completes his grip and swings; seen from above and then from a wider view, he wears a turquoise and light-striped golf shirt, dark trousers, and white shoes. He follows through with the club high over his shoulder on a manicured tee box under a bright blue sky, with trees and rolling green hills behind him. The scene shifts from golf to a dark Lincoln sedan moving along a tree-lined road. At first, only parts of the front end are glimpsed through leafy branches and tree trunks: the rectangular headlights, amber turn signal, chrome trim, and the tall vertical-bar grille with the Lincoln hood ornament above it. Its broad, formal front is clearly visible: a large chrome-framed grille, rectangular headlights, amber lamps at the inner sides, white side mirrors, and a long dark hood. White on-screen text appears along the bottom: “17 City 23 Hwy. EPA Estimates.” The car continues toward the viewer, filling more of the image, with the fuel-economy text remaining at the bottom. A close view follows of the Lincoln branding on the car’s body. The chrome letters spelling “LINCOLN” stand out against the dark glossy paint, catching bright highlights. The surface reflects light and shadow, emphasizing the polished finish. The car is then shown in side profile driving across a green park-like setting, still glossy black with chrome trim along the doors and around the windows. Large white promotional text overlays the lower half of the image: “NOW GET $1,000 CASH BACK ON ’92 LINCOLN TOWN CAR.” Beneath it, smaller fine print runs across the bottom, including wording about cash back from Lincoln-Mercury, taking new retail delivery from dealer stock by 12/31/91, and seeing the dealer for details. The sedan continues smoothly from left to right past lawns, trees, and flowering shrubs. Inside the car, the view moves through the rear passenger area. A wide rear seat cushion with stitched panels fills the lower portion, while the back of the front seat and its rounded headrest appear in the foreground. Across the far side are a dark door panel, a chrome door handle, controls, and a band of warm woodgrain trim. Its chrome wheel trim, rectangular side windows, and long body line remain visible as it moves away. In the final view, the rear of the car recedes into the trees, with a wide red taillight strip and chrome bumper briefly visible before the vehicle disappears farther down the winding, shaded road.

A dark, shadowy engine compartment fills the screen, lit so that the metal parts gleam against a black background. A silver engine block sits horizontally, with ribbed covers, bolts, curved silver pipes below, a small red component near the lower left, and bright red ignition wires running across the top. The view moves progressively closer into the engine as the outer surfaces seem to give way to exposed internal parts. The ribbed cover is replaced by visible mechanical pieces: red wires arch over grey metal housings, then dark cylindrical camshafts and rounded valve components appear inside a pale metal frame. The imagery continues deeper into the engine. Rows of circular openings, bolts, and dark valve heads pass by in close-up, all in cool grey and black metal. The engine becomes more abstract and tunnel-like as the view centers on a single large circular cylinder opening. The round bore dominates the screen, with surrounding bolt holes and machined metal surfaces framing it. Inside, a pale piston face moves within the cylinder, sliding up and down like a flat round disk in a metal tube. Suddenly the grey mechanical view is interrupted by bright orange, red, and white flashes that fill the cylinder area, resembling bursts of heat or combustion. The screen alternates between the cool grey piston moving in the cylinder and fiery orange-red overlays, suggesting intense heat inside the engine. The piston repeatedly rises close to the top of the circular bore, then drops back, while glowing flashes flare across the metal. The hot imagery becomes more frequent: white-hot centers surrounded by orange and red clouds appear over the cylinder, then fade back to the metal piston surface. After this sequence of repeated piston movement and heat bursts, a bottle of Castrol GTX motor oil appears alone on a dark stage. It stands upright in the center on a white, dotted or grid-like floor that recedes into darkness. The bottle is light-colored with a red cap. Its front label shows the Castrol name in red, “GTX” in large black letters, and green and red blocks, with “Super Multi-Grade” and “Motor Oil” visible on the label. Large glossy red block letters begin to rise in front of the bottle, partially covering it. The words build into a stacked message in bold three-dimensional capitals: “ONLY CASTROL PROVIDES MAXIMUM PROTECTION AGAINST VISCOSITY AND THERMAL BREAKDOWN.” As the text grows taller and fills most of the screen, the bottle remains behind it, visible through gaps or below the lower lines. The red lettering dominates the image against the black background, while the bottle stays centered on the illuminated dotted floor. The commercial returns to the engine interior. The circular cylinder and piston are shown again, now with a red glowing ring around the piston area. The piston continues its up-and-down motion inside the grey metal bore. Bright white flashes and orange-red combustion-like bursts alternate with the mechanical view, making the cylinder appear extremely hot. The red ring remains visible around the moving piston in several shots, reinforcing the impression of heat and stress inside the engine. Finally, the Castrol GTX bottle returns alone on the same dark stage and glowing dotted floor. It stands centered, upright, with its red cap and front label facing forward. At the bottom of the screen, bold red three-dimensional text appears: “ENGINEERED FOR TODAY’S SMALLER CARS.” The bottle remains above the slogan, lit from below and surrounded by darkness.

A crowded, dim interior is washed in green light. Young adults and older adults sit close together in rows that slope downward, like a theater or auditorium. A young man with short hair, tinted completely green by the lighting, wears a light jacket over a shirt and forces his way past people in the aisle. He leans over shoulders, grips another person’s arm for balance, and pushes forward with an urgent, intent expression. A young woman with long hair, also green-lit, smiles slightly as she moves through the crowd. From behind, the green-clad young man runs down the center aisle toward a red-lit stage or screen at the front while gray-suited audience members rise or turn to watch. The scene cuts into Nintendo 64 game footage from a first-person shooter. A bright blue sky hangs over a downtown skyline of tall glass office buildings. The image returns briefly to a cleaner, front-facing view of a yellow taxi driving smoothly down the broad road. The commercial is in black and white and opens in a leafy florist’s shop or greenhouse. The shopkeeper reaches into a jar or container on the counter and offers the boy a small round lollipop on a stick. The boy accepts it, smiling shyly and looking down at the candy. He holds the paper bag up beside his face and then brings the lollipop to his mouth, looking pleased as he tastes it. The commercial then moves outdoors to an Esso service station. Two tall, rounded gasoline pumps stand side by side near a car. The pumps have large “Esso” lettering at the top. A uniformed attendant in a cap and work coveralls stands beside the rear of a dark car, holding a gasoline nozzle inserted near the car’s back fender. A full view of one pump fills the screen. The top panel reads “Esso” in large dark letters. On the pump face, the price and measurement windows are visible, including the words “THIS SALE” and “GALLONS,” with the sale display at zero. An attendant steps in from the side and works near the pump, handling the hose and pump equipment. The focus shifts toward another pump labeled “Esso Extra.” Its rounded top carries the brand name, and in a closer view the upper face clearly reads “Esso EXTRA,” with a small “Gilbarco” maker’s badge above it. Small printed notices appear on either side of the pump window, including “GLASS MUST BE FULL” on the left. Two male service station attendants in matching coveralls and caps now stand between the pumps. Both have large Esso patches on their chests. The attendant on the left stands between the left pump and the center pump, smiling and gesturing with one hand. The attendant on the right leans casually against the center pump, hands moving as if speaking or keeping rhythm. The pumps flank them like upright pillars, each with the Esso name at the top and rectangular panels lower down. The men look cheerful and animated, turning toward each other and then toward the pumps. One places a hand on the left pump while the other touches or gestures toward the center pump, as if presenting the two gasoline choices. Near the end of this section, both men look upward and point in the same direction. An oval hanging sign appears against a softly blurred outdoor background. It is suspended from a horizontal metal rod by small hooks and reads “Esso DEALER” in bold dark letters on a light oval field with a dark border. The sign grows larger until it fills the screen. As it enlarges, the lettering begins to change. The word “Esso” stretches and distorts, and the word “DEALER” below smears into dark shapes. Gradually, the sign transforms into a cartoon face inside the same oval outline. The former lettering becomes expressive features: wide eyes, thick arched eyebrows, a small nose, and a broad toothy grin. The animated face smiles broadly, opens and closes its mouth as if speaking, and shifts through several cheerful expressions. Its eyes widen, the mouth changes from a grin to an open smile and back again, and finally one eye closes in a playful wink before returning to a bright, wide-eyed smile.

In black and white, a teenage girl stands at a row of school lockers in a hallway. The cotton test is repeated visually: the witch’s gloved hand again brings a fluffy white cotton pad close to the girl’s hair. The image overlaps briefly with the girl holding the can, connecting the product use with the test. The boy sits close beside her, looking at her and reaching toward the end of her hair. The Hidden Magic can fills the screen, its swirling patterned label and large “Hidden Magic” name clearly visible. The can then appears standing upright with its pale cap on, placed on a simple display surface. To the right of the can, large block lettering reads: “THE PROBLEM SOLVING HAIR SPRAY.”

A woman and a small child walk together along a sunlit park path. The woman, a young adult with dark hair, wears a black-and-white checkered dress, a light cardigan, and low heels. Another woman and child appear in a tree-lined city park. The adult woman, dressed smartly in a light-colored coat over a skirt and heels, carries a rectangular handbag in one hand. She holds the hand of a little girl wearing a dark pinafore over a light long-sleeved top. The child is walking along the seat of a wooden park bench while the woman walks on the path beside it, carefully balancing her pace with the child’s. A young adult man with dark, curly, wind-tossed hair stands on a sailboat beside the mast. He wears a tan or golden-brown sailing jacket with a pale zipper and trim, over a dark shirt, with white trousers. Around him are vertical mast poles, taut rigging lines, and a wrapped sail or boom, with a pale cloudy sky behind him. He grips a rope with both hands and pulls upward, bracing one leg as if working the rigging. His expression is strained and determined, teeth clenched as he looks upward and then toward the viewer. He pauses beside the mast, still holding the rope, and his jacket is shown prominently: high at the neck, loose through the body, with the pale zipper line running down the front. He lets go of the rope and stands more upright, looking out across the boat and water with a steady, confident expression. He folds his arms across his chest, the sleeves of the tan jacket bunching slightly at the elbows, and turns his head from side to side as though surveying the weather and the horizon. He then lowers his arms and reaches to the front of the jacket. With one hand at the collar, he pulls the zipper upward, closing the jacket higher around his neck. The collar rises snugly under his chin, emphasizing the jacket as protective outerwear. He continues looking off to the side, calm and composed, while the mast and rigging remain close behind him. A burst of water or heavy spray suddenly washes down over his head and face, briefly veiling him in a pale sheet of wetness. His hair and face are drenched, but he remains upright, wearing the zipped jacket. As the spray clears, he looks to the side again with a faintly satisfied, resilient expression, shoulders squared and hands near his hips. The tan jacket still dominates the image, its front zipper and high collar clearly visible. He shifts into a more relaxed, swaggering pose on the sailboat, one hand at his hip. He raises a small pipe to his mouth and then stands with the pipe held between his lips, looking outward. The full outfit is visible now: the tan jacket ending at the waist over bright white pants, with the mast rising behind him and rigging lines stretching upward on both sides. The confident stance becomes comic when he suddenly loses balance near the boom. He lurches sideways and drops out of his upright pose. In a wider view, he is sprawled awkwardly across a long horizontal boom, clutching it with his arms while his white-clad legs kick outward. He slides and twists around the boom, then disappears in a blur of movement and spray near the mast, suggesting he has fallen or been knocked down on the boat. The scene opens out to a distant view of a small white sailboat moving on open water under a pale sky, with a low strip of dark shoreline or trees at the far left. Over this water view, large bold black text appears across the upper part of the image: “The Event Maker: Sailing Jacket by H.I.S. Of Caprolan nylon by Allied Chemical.” The boat remains small beneath the text, centered on the horizon with rippling water in the foreground.

A young blonde flight attendant in a bright orange United uniform and matching pillbox-style cap fills the screen. She wears white gloves and holds a pale balloon close to her mouth, inflating it. The commercial begins in black and white with a tight view of the Polaroid Big Swinger instant camera held in someone’s hands. A small metal ring or tab is pulled, a hinged section swings open, and a dark rectangular film compartment is exposed. The hands place or adjust a flat dark panel inside, then close the camera back. On the rear of the camera there is a rectangular instruction label filled with small printed lines, though the wording is too small to read clearly. The setting shifts outdoors into very bright sunlight. The first glimpses are high-contrast silhouettes and soft glare, with faces and horse shapes partly washed out by the sun. Young adult riders come into view on horseback, moving through an open, rural-looking area with trees in the background. There are several riders, both men and women, wearing casual 1960s riding clothes rather than formal equestrian gear. Dust rises around the horses’ legs as they move along a path or field. Beside and behind her are young men on horses, one in a light ribbed turtleneck-style sweater with a dark stripe at the collar and cuffs, another in a light open jacket or shirt over a darker top. Their horses include dark and light-colored mounts, with bridles and reins visible. The riders look relaxed and playful, smiling as they ride toward the viewer under open sky. The camera is shown bouncing lightly against a rider’s thigh while the horse moves, emphasizing that it is being carried along during the ride. The young woman with the headband appears again from a low angle, smiling with the wind moving her hair. A young man on horseback grins broadly, his hair ruffled, while the horse’s head fills part of the foreground. Another woman rider appears behind a horse’s head, smiling as the horse tosses its mane. One young man in the light sweater lifts the Big Swinger to his face while seated on his horse. He holds the camera with both hands, brings the viewfinder to his eye, and aims it across the group. The horse’s head is close beside him, its mane and bridle visible. After using the camera, he lowers it and laughs. Another smiling young man in a white sweater playfully holds the camera out toward the viewer, tilting the front so the round lens and square face are prominent. The woman with the headband rides past again, smiling. Then her hands are shown working with a fresh instant photograph. She holds a pale rectangular print in one hand and a darker backing or negative sheet in the other, peeling the two apart. A large white-bordered black-and-white photograph is then displayed. In the picture, the headbanded woman is captured riding in the open field, smiling over her shoulder, with her hair blown back and the landscape stretching behind her. A thumb holds the lower corner of the print, making its large size clear. The young man in the light sweater looks off to the side and gestures, as if calling someone’s attention. The woman with the headband reacts with a wide open-mouthed expression, smiling or laughing while clutching the reins and the camera against her chest. The man smiles back. She then raises the Big Swinger to her own face, holding it with both hands and aiming it while her hair blows sideways in the wind. After taking the picture, she lowers the camera and pulls a long sheet or developing strip from it, then peels apart another instant print. The riders continue moving together through the field. The headbanded woman rides at one side, and a young man on a dark horse rides near the center, with another rider behind them. The scene remains bright and outdoorsy, with trees, open sky, and dust in the background. Another finished white-bordered photograph is held up: it shows a smiling young man on horseback, turned toward the camera with a horse and a large tree behind him. The print is held close enough that the image fills most of the view. The young woman with the headband is shown again holding the camera near her waist as she rides. She smiles and points forward, appearing to direct attention toward another subject. A young man in the open light jacket laughs on horseback while holding the Big Swinger. A blonde young woman in a dark turtleneck and a dark cap rides nearby, smiling broadly over her shoulder. Her light hair is gathered back, and the cap sits low and jaunty on her head. The man in the light jacket turns toward her, then raises the Big Swinger to his eye, holding the reins and camera strap while aiming at her from horseback. The blonde woman in the dark cap smiles and poses as she rides, one hand on the reins. She looks lively and amused, with the horse’s ears and mane entering the foreground. The man continues aiming the camera at her. Afterward, his hands are shown peeling apart another instant photograph against the front of his clothing. He separates a pale print from a dark backing sheet. A closer view shows the sunglasses-wearing adult bear without the sunglasses now, with a little white flower on the head, standing at a large beige suitcase on the bed. The flower-wearing adult bear then presents a large red-and-white Charmin Ultra Strong package. The package is held between the two adult bears and fills much of the view. It has the blue Charmin logo in white script, the words “ULTRA STRONG” in bold white letters on a red background, and “MEGA” near the top. A picture on the package shows the Charmin bear characters with a toilet. The bear in the blue shirt brightens and takes hold of the package, smiling. The other adult bear lets go and steps aside, while the blue-shirted bear proudly holds the package up toward the viewer. A product demonstration follows in a bathroom-like setting. A white roll of toilet paper sits on a small wooden bench with a green rug below and a blurred white toilet in the background. A sheet unrolls forward. At first the paper appears plain and smooth. As it continues to roll out, the surface changes to a raised, quilted texture with swirls, loops, and patterned embossing. The texture becomes more pronounced, covering the sheet in a soft, washcloth-like raised pattern as it drapes over the bench. On both sides, a strip of white toilet paper is stretched horizontally with small metal weights or cylinders stacked on top. A hand above each strip uses a dropper to add liquid. The left side is labeled with a purple badge reading “Leading Bargain Brand x4,” while the right side shows the “Charmin Ultra Strong” logo. The scene returns to the beach. The red bear family is now on a sunny tropical shoreline with pale sand, blue water in the foreground, rows of palm trees, and hazy mountains in the distance. One adult red bear stands near the water with hands on hips, chest out, looking pleased. The sunglasses-wearing adult bear reclines on a blue lounge chair, wearing white sunglasses and holding a pineapple-shaped tropical drink with a straw, fruit garnish, and small umbrella. Two smaller cubs run off to the right in the background. The standing adult bear begins to move playfully along the edge of the water, stepping and swinging the arms as if dancing or celebrating. The reclining bear watches from the lounge chair, smiling and holding the pineapple drink. In a closer view, the lounging bear adjusts the white sunglasses with one paw while still holding the drink in the other. The standing bear comes into the foreground beside the lounge chair, leaning in affectionately. The two adult bears face each other, smiling; the standing bear gestures near the other bear’s chin, and the reclining bear smiles back. The commercial ends on a clean light-blue background with a large Charmin logo: a dark blue cloud shape with “Charmin” in white script. A white ribbon of toilet paper curls beneath it, carrying the words “enjoy the go” in light blue lowercase letters. A red Charmin bear walks in from the right, stops beside the logo, and raises one paw in a friendly wave while smiling.

The stain-removal head is also demonstrated on a black car seat or dark upholstery outdoors or near greenery. The clear triangular head presses onto a damp, speckled section of the seat. On-screen text reads “2X MORE STAIN-GRABBING SUCTION,” with a “Powered by StainForce” badge and fine print along the bottom. As the tool moves, the treated area looks less wet and more uniform. A split-screen view shows two messes being cleaned at once. On the left, the black hose nozzle sucks up spaghetti noodles and orange sauce from upholstery. The noodles disappear into the nozzle, leaving a smeared but reduced mess. On the right, the clear stain tool is pushed across a gray upholstered chair seat with orange sauce marks, lifting a cleaner rectangular path through the stains. The orange marks fade where the tool passes. The dirty collection container inside the Shark machine is shown from above, filled with sucked-up spaghetti, sauce, and cloudy liquid. Hands lift the container out of the green machine. The mess inside is visible through the translucent plastic, with noodles gathered at the bottom and sauce streaks on the sides. For cleaning the tool afterward, the Shark EveryMess sits on a white countertop beside a clear glass of water. The woman holds the black hose nozzle over the glass, then dips it into the water. A graphic at the lower left reads “RINSE & READY TECHNOLOGY.” She swirls or runs the nozzle in the water while the hose remains attached to the machine. The view shifts to the side of the green machine, where the translucent tank shows cloudy water moving inside. Large white text across the machine reads “SELF-CLEANS IN SECONDS,” reinforcing the rinse-cleaning step. Near the end, the black Shark floor nozzle glides across a glossy white floor, picking up small dark crumbs or dirt. Another scene shows the cylindrical dry nozzle pressed into a mound of soil, mulch, and small leaves. The nozzle draws the loose dirt inward, creating a shallow cleared trench in the pile. The clear StainForce head returns on the pale rug, moving forward between the woman’s knees as she kneels behind it. The rug ahead is clean and light-colored; the tool’s transparent chamber shows moisture and foam being pulled through as it passes. The bottle of StainForce cleaner stands upright nearby. The final product display shows the Shark EveryMess and its accessories arranged on a clean white counter in a bright modern home with large windows and wood ceiling beams. The green-and-teal main unit sits centered with its black hose coiled along the base. The scene returns to the kitchen, where loose Reese’s Pieces and wrapped candies fly through the air in a stream. Orange, yellow, and brown pieces arc across the room, along with small wrapped candies. They move in a long, curving trail, passing in front of cabinets and the kitchen counter. E.T., the small brown alien character, is now visible in the kitchen. He has a wrinkled, leathery face, a long thin neck, large wide-set eyes, and a small body with narrow shoulders. He stands upright in the foreground, looking toward the flying candy with a calm, curious expression. The candies continue to sail past E.T. in slow, graceful arcs. Some pass close to his face, and a few appear to drift toward his mouth. Behind him are wooden cabinets, a sink beneath a window with closed blinds, curtains, and countertop items such as a red bowl and kitchen utensils. E.T.’s head turns slightly as he watches the colorful pieces move around him. His large eyes follow the candies, and his mouth forms a small, pleased smile. A few candies hover directly in front of E.T.’s face, then one reaches his mouth. He appears to eat or taste it, his expression softening into satisfaction. He raises one long, thin finger beside his face. The fingertip begins to glow with a warm yellow-white light, standing out against the dark kitchen. Small Reese’s Pieces continue to drift behind and near him, their orange and yellow colors echoing the glow at the end of his finger. E.T. looks at the glowing fingertip with quiet focus, as if his familiar glowing touch has been sparked by the candy moment. The final image is a simple brand card: the word “Reese’s” in large yellow script with a dark outline, centered on a warm orange background. The logo remains steady and uncluttered, ending the sequence with the Reese’s name filling the screen.

The scene moves to nighttime outside a theater. Kermit stands in front of a lit marquee with a sign reading “THE PRODUCERS,” with smaller text above that appears to reference Mel Brooks. The images are in stark black and white. A large, formal boardroom appears, with a long glossy conference table stretching toward the viewer and rows of empty leather chairs along both sides. One white-haired man steps forward through the crowd, while behind him another man appears to be forced backward by the arrival of yet another suited figure. The glossy table now reflects the dense cluster of bodies. The room becomes packed with businessmen. A balding man stands in the center looking alert and tense, surrounded by many similar men in suits. Their hands and faces are visible through the glass. The glass then becomes covered with a speckled, cloudy pattern, obscuring the men behind it until they look like a pale, grainy mass. From above, groups of dark-suited figures move across city pavement. Seen from high overhead, the men look small and numerous, with long shadows stretching beside them. They stream and cluster together in an urban street grid between tall buildings. The crowd becomes a dense, dark, rounded mass moving through an intersection, like a swarm. Across the lower center of the X-ray, black text appears and becomes readable: “As they continue to grow, we continue to die.” The final image holds on the X-ray with that message, visually connecting the multiplying corporate figures to disease in the lungs.

The commercial opens on a warm, sunlit tropical beach. Palm fronds and pink flowers fill the left side and upper edge, partly framing a bright ocean beyond. An adult man with light skin and neatly combed brown hair faces forward outdoors, with dark green wooded hills behind him. The commercial opens in a dark, misty jungle at night or in very low light, tinted blue-purple. Dark silhouettes of tree branches and a low orange sun ripple across the paint and window glass. The black side mirror and chrome-like window trim frame the reflection. The windshield appears dark, so no occupants are visible. The car advances slowly toward the foreground, still bathed in sunset tones, presenting the Lexus ES 300 as a refined four-door sedan moving through a quiet, scenic road.

The commercial opens in warm, hazy light, looking past a dark vertical obstruction as if from behind a doorway or pillar. Beige leather seats fill the view: the front passenger seat in the foreground with a broad padded headrest, and a rear bench behind it with three seating positions and vertical seat belts at the sides. The upholstery is plush, with stitched panels and gathered detailing near the upper backrests. Warm sunlight and shadow move across the seats, emphasizing the roomy, open-looking interior. The commercial returns to fast-moving exterior views of the road and rocky hillside, rendered as streaks of gold and brown. The Infiniti passes again in side view through the sunlit scrub, its headlights flaring and the roofline catching a bright highlight. As it continues, the rear half of the car crosses the screen, leaving a glowing trail of dust and warm light behind it. From the rear, the black sedan drives away into an orange-lit haze. Red taillights glow on both sides, the Infiniti emblem sits centered on the trunk, and a “G20” badge is visible on the right side of the rear. Dust rises around the tires and softens the outline of the car as it recedes. Inside again, the driver is shown in silhouette from the passenger side. He sits upright with both hands near the steering wheel, facing the road ahead. The dashboard and center stack are visible to his right, with rectangular vents and controls. Through the windshield and side windows, rocky slopes and sunlit roadside brush pass by, bathing the interior in warm amber light. The view briefly looks upward through tall trees, with the sun blazing through branches and leaves. The bright white-gold sun is partially blocked by trunks and foliage, creating a shimmering, outdoor sense of speed and openness. The black Infiniti then approaches head-on along a dusty, sunlit road. Its headlights glow yellow, and a bright highlight runs along the top edge of the hood and roof. At the end, large on-screen text appears over the darkened image of the car: “G20” in big white letters, with the price “$21,485” below. Smaller fine print underneath reads that the price is M.S.R.P., fully equipped including destination charges, and that title, taxes, and license fees are not included.

A young girl stands centered on a small stage in front of dark blue curtains, facing a tall black microphone. She has light skin, long brown hair in two braids, large clear-framed glasses, and a neat school-uniform look: a white collared shirt under a red plaid jumper, with large dark blue bows near her shoulders. She looks composed and confident, with a slight smile, as if performing in a spelling bee or school recital. While speaking, she gestures delicately with one hand near the microphone, then raises both hands to adjust her glasses at the temples. Her expression stays calm and self-assured as she finishes, looking straight ahead. The scene widens to reveal the stage more fully. An American flag stands on a pole at the left, blue curtains hang on both sides, and a square black mat or shadowed area lies on the wooden floor. Suddenly, an enormous gray cube descends into the center of the stage, filling the space where the girl had been. Its surface is mottled and metallic-looking, and a bright circular spotlight washes across its front face. The cube lands upright, massive and imposing, with the flag still visible beside it. The visuals then switch into the video game world: a glossy, dark, grid-like platform floating in black space. Large blocks form a moving wall ahead, made of gray cubes mixed with solid black cubes and glowing green cubes. The character runs along the grid as the block formations advance. A wider view shows multiple rows of blocks sliding forward like a wave across a long tiled pathway. The green cubes glow with a watery neon texture, the black cubes look dangerous and opaque, and the gray cubes have a cloudy metal sheen. In one moment, the character is hemmed in beside a high wall of blocks as a bright white block rises or flashes nearby, making the character appear very small against the massive cube surfaces. In another, the character runs along the edge of a stepped cube formation, close to glowing green blocks and a black cube set into the grid. As the blocks continue to shift, the character loses footing near the edge of the platform. The figure tips backward with arms raised and falls away from the tiled surface into black emptiness. Several views show the character tumbling between huge floating gray cubes, limbs splayed, shrinking against the surrounding block structures. The commercial returns to the stage. The giant gray cube now stands in the center under the circular spotlight, with mist or smoke drifting near its upper left edge. The American flag remains at the left, and the blue curtains frame the scene. Across the front face of the cube, black-and-white block lettering spells the game title: “Intelligent Qube.”

A red car tries to squeeze into a tight parking space along a curb on a city street, seen from high above. Large hot-pink text reads “LESS THAN $15,” first over a fighting game screen and then over a board-game-like screen with colored squares around the edge. It is printed with “SOLOFLEX” and shipping markings including “THIS SIDE UP,” “LAY FLAT,” and “DO NOT PLACE ON END.” The worker grips the hand truck handle and smiles toward the viewer as the oversized package dominates the scene. The Soloflex machine itself is then shown assembled on the white studio floor. It has a vertical upright post, a curved support frame, a flat padded bench, a horizontal bar, and a base labeled “SOLOFLEX.” The design is compact and minimal, with dark metal parts standing out against the pale background. The phone number reappears once more, centered on a black bar with an arrow pointing toward it. A shirtless, athletic adult man in light shorts begins demonstrating exercises on the machine. In a close view, he stands beside the vertical post and grips a horizontal bar with both hands at hip level, performing a curl-like movement as the bar rises toward his waist. A drawn arrow points toward the machine’s upright column. His posture is controlled, and his gaze is directed downward toward the bar. The exercise sequence continues with the same man lying on an angled bench, knees bent and feet braced against the machine. With his hands near his head, he curls his upper body upward in a sit-up or abdominal crunch. The machine’s curved frame and upright post are visible to the side, and a black arrow points toward his bent legs and the movement area. He then appears front-facing with a padded bar across the back of his shoulders, squatting on the machine platform. His knees are bent, feet planted, and he rises through the squat with a focused expression. A high-contrast silhouette follows: the man’s body is shown in black profile against a white background, with his legs bent and supported near the machine’s upright post. He curls his torso upward toward his knees, emphasizing an abdominal movement. The vertical post with a line of adjustment holes appears at the left, and a drawn arrow points down toward his torso and knees. The silhouette makes the body position and movement stand out clearly. In a low, close view from beside the bench, the shirtless man lies on his back and grips a bar above his chest for a press. His hands hold the bar wide apart; his arms bend and extend as the bar moves over his chest and toward his face. The machine’s metal frame surrounds him, and a black arrow points toward his chest and the pressing motion. His muscles are highlighted by the black-and-white lighting. Another silhouette exercise is shown in profile. The man holds a handle or bar close to his chin with one fist while a long resistance arm angles back toward the machine on the right. He leans back and lowers his upper body, then pulls against the resistance, the fist staying near his face as the arm and shoulder engage. A black arrow points from the right toward the working position. The phone number “1-800-762-FREE” returns again on the plain white background, with an arrow pointing up toward it. A round wall clock appears, black-rimmed with large numbers and hands clustered around 12, suggesting a short amount of time. A hand-drawn arrow points toward the clock. The visual shifts to a flipping desk calendar. A page marked “MONDAY 13” is visible in bold type, surrounded by blurred duplicate calendar pages as if time is passing quickly. A hand turns the page, and the calendar changes to “WEDNESDAY 15.” The Wednesday page remains centered for several moments, then another hand turn reveals “FRIDAY 17.” The pages are large, with bold black numbers and weekday names on white paper, held on metal rings at the top. The phone number appears again with an arrow pointing down to it. A shaggy, light-colored dog sits alone on the white background, facing forward with an alert, friendly expression. Its mouth is slightly open, and its ears hang down. A black arrow points toward the dog’s head, visually matching the spoken reference to how the dog looks. A close-up of a shirtless torso and loose jeans follows. The waist of the jeans appears too large, with extra space around the abdomen. A hand pulls a belt strap across the front, showing multiple belt holes as it tightens the pants. A black arrow points toward the slimmer waist area and the looseness of the jeans. The phone number returns again, centered on the white background with an arrow pointing upward at it. The athletic man reappears from the chest up, shirtless and sweaty, facing forward. At first the phone number briefly overlays his chest, then disappears. He throws his head back with his mouth wide open, fists clenched near his sides and chest, as if exulting after a workout. His hair is damp and pushed back, his eyes close or squint with effort, and sweat glistens down the center of his chest. He continues pumping his arms and holding the triumphant open-mouthed expression while a black arrow at the left points toward him. The phone number “1-800-762-FREE” appears once more on a black rectangular bar with a downward arrow above it. The final product image returns: the Soloflex machine stands alone on the white background, with the large bold word “SOLOFLEX” above it and the base also labeled “SOLOFLEX.” The commercial ends on the phone number again, now surrounded by many hand-drawn black arrows from every direction, all pointing inward toward “1-800-762-FREE.”

A huge mosquito fills the screen in extreme close-up, far larger than life. Its body is dark and glossy with purplish highlights, covered in bristly hairs, and its large green compound eyes glitter with a dotted texture. Its long needle-like proboscis points forward while its thin legs and translucent wings blur around it against a hazy purple-gray background, making it look as if it is hovering or closing in. A young teenage boy sits centered on a pale couch, facing a large dark television set in the foreground with his hands held low as if using a game controller. Around him are casual household items: a plaid blanket draped over the couch to his right, papers or magazines on the cushions, and furniture and stairs visible in the background. Back on the couch, the boy turns his eyes sideways with a wary, uneasy expression. The mosquito is then shown in profile perched on human skin, its spindly legs planted among visible fine hairs. Its pale, translucent wings glow at the edges, and its long proboscis presses into the skin as if biting. The commercial switches to video game footage: first a fighting game scene with stone columns, statues, and a blue background, with two characters battling while a rating box marked “MA-13” sits at the lower right and small text along the bottom says that Sega Genesis game screens are shown. One fighter is knocked or thrown across the screen. Then basketball game footage appears in a crowded arena, with players in bright uniforms leaping near the hoop; a “GA” rating box appears at the lower right, and small white game-screen text remains along the bottom. The dog sits or pauses near the center-left, looking up or toward the children. The jumping boy reaches high and appears to tap or toss the ball upward. The large striped ball rises and drifts left to right above the group. The children spread out along the sand, some with arms lifted, others running to get into position. Inside a dimly lit public transit vehicle, likely a bus or train, passengers sit in close rows. The light washes the previously blue, nocturnal city with a warmer glow. The roosters remain gathered on stone ledges and in the plaza below, many with open beaks and raised heads. From above, the flock becomes a dense, shifting mass in the streets, like a moving pattern of small dark and pale shapes. A wider city view shows the birds spilling down an avenue away from the columned building, occupying the road between tall office blocks while a few vehicles sit off to the sides. A high, almost map-like view looks straight down on blocks of buildings and streets, with sunlight striking rooftops and facades. The perspective pulls away into a larger grid of the city. On the ground, a sidewalk and street are littered with scattered boxes, bags, and debris near a white service or sanitation truck. Orange-and-white traffic barrels and barriers sit near the disturbance, and mist spreads across the road. From a low angle, the bus looms large as it drives past, headlights glowing, while debris and dark fragments swirl behind it in the bright, backlit haze between the buildings. The city recedes until it becomes small within a broad expanse of blue-gray atmosphere. The image continues outward to the curve of the Earth from space. Orange road lines, green areas, and blue water shapes fill the tablet screen, while several round vehicle-and-gauge markers are scattered across it. The hand taps the central marker with the blue car. A white information panel opens over the map on the tablet. The same hand reaches in, picks up the keys, and turns them in the palm. The blue tag and metal key ring swing as the hand closes around them, visually suggesting taking possession of the car. The interface header at the top reads “Kelley Blue Book.” As the tablet settles, the blue Chevrolet Volt listing appears again with the price gauge. Above the tablet, a yellow circular icon and white text appear: “Kelley Blue Book Price Advisor.”

Two upright kitchen sponges stand on a glossy white counter like little racers: a blue sponge on the left and a yellow sponge on the right. Stacks of white plates sit in the background, and the surface reflects the sponges. As the scene opens up, a translucent blue bottle of Dawn dish soap appears beside the blue sponge, while a tall yellow bottle labeled “Dish Liquid” stands beside the yellow sponge. The yellow bottle has a blue label with red “DISH LIQUID” lettering and a lemon image. The kitchen setting becomes clearer: a deep white sink filled with blue-tinted water stretches across the foreground, with bits and spots of greasy residue floating on the surface, dark blue tile along the back wall, stacks of dishes on both sides, and a tall silver faucet to the right. The sponges wiggle and bend as if preparing for a race. The blue sponge is paired with the Dawn bottle on the left; the yellow sponge is paired with the generic-looking dish liquid on the right. Both face the water-filled sink, with their reflections visible in the glossy counter and water below. The sink looks almost like a miniature swimming pool, with scattered yellow-brown grease spots on and under the water’s surface. A more controlled demonstration follows. Two light-skinned hands hold small rectangular pieces of sponge over two long, narrow grey lanes on a white surface. The blue sponge piece is placed on the left lane in front of the Dawn bottle, and the yellow sponge piece is placed on the right lane in front of the yellow “Dish Liquid” bottle. Both lanes show streaks and patches of orange-brown grease. Very small white fine print appears along the bottom, describing test conditions, though it is difficult to read fully. The hands lower the sponges onto the greasy lanes, then lift away, leaving the two sponge pieces upright at the start of their tracks. The scene shifts back to the sink. The blue and yellow sponges leap into the blue water, causing splashes and ripples. The bottles remain standing on the counter behind them, Dawn on the left and the yellow dish liquid on the right. Water sprays up around the sponges as they tumble and skim across the surface. The yellow sponge floats and flops near the back and side, while the blue sponge moves more vigorously through the water, churning up foam and splashes. Seen from the side at water level, both sponges ride low in the water, their porous surfaces dripping. The blue sponge surfaces near the Dawn bottle, then dips and surges forward again. The yellow sponge bobs nearby but appears less forceful. Underwater, the sponges are visible as soft rectangular shapes moving through blue water with trails of bubbles. The blue sponge dives and rolls, while the yellow sponge hangs farther away, smaller and lower in the scene. Above the surface, the blue sponge repeatedly breaks through the water, standing up on an edge, then plunging back down with splashes. The race-like action continues in the sink. The blue sponge cuts across the water, leaving ripples and bursts of foam behind it. The yellow sponge appears off to the side and behind. The Dawn bottle stands close at the left edge of the counter, and the yellow dish liquid bottle is farther back. The blue sponge rises dramatically near the edge of the sink, upright like a fin, dripping water as it slows near the Dawn bottle, while the yellow sponge floats lower in the background. The comparison resolves into a product display. On a bright white counter, the blue Dawn bottle and the yellow “Dish Liquid” bottle stand side by side. A very tall stack of clean white plates stands to the left of Dawn, while a noticeably shorter stack of plates sits to the right of the yellow dish liquid, visually suggesting Dawn cleaned more dishes. Small white on-screen text near the bottom reads, “Per drop, while suds last.” The bottles are centered between the plate stacks in a clean, sunlit kitchen. The final display shows four Dawn bottles lined up on the counter in different colors: yellow, blue, orange, and green, each with a white cap and the Dawn logo on the front. A large blue sponge slides across the foreground from left to right like a wipe, covering and revealing parts of the bottles as it passes. It clears to a mostly white end screen with dark teal text reading “visit dawn-dish.com” and the Dawn logo below. A green Dawn bottle remains partly visible at the far right edge beside the kitchen sink in the background.

The commercial opens inside a cramped, chaotic teenage bedroom. An old gray tube television sits on a wooden dresser, its screen filled with static. A teenager appears to be lying in the bed, mostly covered, with part of a bare arm and head visible near the pillow. The person is passive and still, seemingly asleep or resting, while the surrounding room looks disorderly and crowded with teenage belongings. The scene then changes abruptly to a sleek black Hyundai sedan on a wet city street. The car faces forward at first, its headlights glowing amber-white and reflecting on the shiny pavement. The chrome grille and Hyundai badge are prominent at the front, and the glossy hood mirrors the buildings and sky around it. A dark, spacious industrial-looking interior fills the screen, like a warehouse or large studio with high ceilings, metal beams, and dim window panels along the sides. Back in the wide blue scene, the tan Accord faces forward with both headlights on, the boombox wall glowing behind it while the dancers continue synchronized steps. A rear detail shows the “ACCORD” badge on the tan car beside large rectangular taillights. The imagery moves to another era, with a glossy red Accord under purple horizontal light bars. The front headlight assembly is shown in detail: an amber turn-signal section on the outside and clear rectangular lamps stretching inward toward the grille, with purple reflections sliding across the red hood. The red car then appears centered on a dark reflective floor against a wall of evenly spaced purple light strips. Two dancers perform beside it: one on the left in a bright blue outfit with boots, and one on the right in a dark outfit with a colorful jacket or shirt. They swing their arms and step wide as the red Accord sits between them, its sleeker shape and low hood contrasting with the earlier boxier cars. A more dramatic, modern stage follows. At first, only intense blue-white headlights are visible facing forward through haze and darkness, with bright beams streaking across a gray backdrop. The current red Honda Accord emerges in a three-quarter side view. It is a low, sleek, four-door sedan with a long roofline, sculpted sides, large two-tone alloy wheels, slim LED headlights, and a dark front grille with the Honda badge. Small white text near the bottom reads, “2018 Accord Touring 2.0T Shown.” The red paint reflects the moving white light beams and the black floor beneath it.
